RI.mark_waiting(M.state,M.key,payload,{main_lane='eq'}) end local opts={route=M.key,target=target,kind='offense',commit=true,reason=M.key..':'..category} local sent,detail,ack if RI and RI.emit_route_payload then sent,detail,ack=RI.emit_route_payload(M.key,payload,opts) elseif type(Yso.emit)=='function' then sent=Yso.emit(payload,opts);ack=payload end sub.emitting,sub.payload=false,ack if sent~=true then M.clear_runtime();return false,detail or 'emit_failed' end RC.mark_pending(M.state,slot,target,M.cfg.pending_s) RC.note_special_queued(command,target) local bus=Yso.locks and Yso.locks.note_payload and Yso.queue and Yso.queue.commit if not sub.acknowledged and (not bus or (Yso.net and Yso.net.cfg and Yso.net.cfg.dry_run)) then M.on_payload_sent(ack or payload) end M.state.last_cmd,M.state.last_category,M.state.last_target=command,category,target return true,command end function M.on_payload_sent(payload) M.init() if not ready() or type(payload)~='table' then return false end if RI and RI.payload_has_any_route and RI.payload_has_any_route(payload) and not RI.payload_has_route(payload,M.key) then return false end local lanes=payload.lanes or payload local command=lanes.eq or payload.eq if not command and not payload.lanes and not (payload.bal or payload.free or payload.class or payload.ent or payload.entity) then command=payload.cmd end command=RC.trim(command) if command=='' then return false end local sub,latest=M.state.submission,last_ack() if payload==M.state.last_ack_payload or (sub and payload==sub.previous_eq_ack) then return false end local target=RC.trim(payload.target or RC.get_target()) local matched=sub and not sub.acknowledged and command==sub.cmd and RC.same_target(target,sub.target) and (payload==sub.payload or payload==latest) -- Direct/manual API dispatches also reach this hook through the canonical ACK bus. if not matched and payload~=latest then return false end if matched then sub.acknowledged,sub.ack_payload,sub.until_t=true,payload,RC.now()+M.cfg.pending_s RC.mark_pending(M.state,sub.slot,target,M.cfg.pending_s) if RI and RI.clear_waiting then RI.clear_waiting(M.state,M.key) end elseif sub then M.clear_runtime() end M.state.last_ack_payload=payload M.state.firestorm_dispatch=nil if command=='cast firestorm' then local room=room_key() M.state.firestorm_rooms[room]=RC.now() M.state.firestorm_dispatch={payload=payload,room=room,eq_ack=latest} end return true end M.on_payload_queued=M.on_payload_sent function M.on_send_result(payload,ctx) if not (type(ctx)=='table' and ctx.success==false) then return true end local sub,dispatch=M.state.submission,M.state.firestorm_dispatch if dispatch and payload==dispatch.payload then M.state.firestorm_rooms[dispatch.room]=nil M.state.firestorm_dispatch=nil if ready() then RC.clear_pending(M.state,'firestorm') end end if sub and (payload==sub.payload or payload==sub.ack_payload) then M.clear_runtime() end return true end function M.on_resonance_failure(required,element) local dispatch=M.state.firestorm_dispatch if not dispatch or required~=3 or (element~='air' and element~='fire') then return false end local latest=last_ack() if latest and latest~=dispatch.eq_ack and latest~=dispatch.payload then local lanes=latest.lanes or latest if RC.trim(lanes.eq or latest.eq)~='' then M.state.firestorm_dispatch=nil;return false end end return M.on_send_result(dispatch.payload,{success=false}) end function M.on_firestorm_ended(room) M.init() M.state.firestorm_rooms[tostring(room or room_key())]=nil return true end
-- LOOP LIFECYCLE M.alias_loop_stop_details={inactive=true,disabled=true,no_target=true,invalid_target=true,wrong_class=true,core_unavailable=true} function M.alias_loop_prepare_start(ctx) M.clear_runtime();return ctx or {} end function M.alias_loop_on_started() M.clear_runtime();M.state.firestorm_rooms,M.state.firestorm_dispatch={},nil if ready() then RC.entourage_sync(M,RC.get_target(),is_magi()) end notify('Firestorm loop ON.') end function M.alias_loop_on_stopped(ctx) M.clear_runtime();M.state.firestorm_rooms,M.state.firestorm_dispatch={},nil if RC.entourage_passive then RC.entourage_passive(M) end ctx=ctx or {};M.state.template.last_disable_reason=ctx.reason or 'manual' if not ctx.silent then notify('Firestorm loop OFF ('..M.state.template.last_disable_reason..').') end end function M.alias_loop_waiting_blocks() if not ready() then return false end if Yso.offense_paused and Yso.offense_paused() then M.clear_runtime();return false end local sub=flight(RC.get_target()) return sub~=nil and not sub.acknowledged end M.alias_loop_clear_waiting=M.clear_runtime M.on_target_swap=M.clear_runtime M.on_pause=M.clear_runtime function M.alias_loop_on_error(err) notify('Firestorm loop error: '..tostring(err)) end function M.on_exit() M.alias_loop_on_stopped({silent=true,reason='exit'}) if Yso.mode and Yso.mode.stop_route_loop then Yso.mode.stop_route_loop(M.key,'exit',true) end return true end function M.evaluate(ctx) return M.attack_function({preview=true,target=type(ctx)=='table' and ctx.target or nil}) end function M.explain() if not ready() then return {reason='core_unavailable'} end local s=M.snapshot(RC.get_target());s.command,s.category,s.reason=M.choose(s) return s end M.clear_runtime();M.state.firestorm_rooms,M.state.firestorm_dispatch={},nil if Yso.off.core and Yso.off.core.register then Yso.off.core.register(M.key,M) end return M

Script.name: Magi spell feedback
Script.script: -- Confirmed Magi response adapter. Native triggers supply event + named victim. -- AK owns scores/cures. This module never sends commands or estimates enemy HP. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.magi = Yso.magi or {} local T = Yso.magi.spell_feedback or {} Yso.magi.spell_feedback = T T.hypothermia_tracking = true T.observed, T.expiries = T.observed or {}, T.expiries or {} local function core() return Yso.off and Yso.off.magi and Yso.off.magi.route_core end local function now() return core() and core().now() or os.time() end local function current() return core() and core().get_target() or tostring(rawget(_G,'target') or '') end local function same(a,b) return tostring(a or ''):lower()==tostring(b or ''):lower() end local function tracking_ready() if type(ak)~='table' or type(affstrack)~='table' or type(affstrack.score)~='table' then return false end if type(ak.ai)=='function' then local ok, blocked=pcall(ak.ai) if not ok or blocked then return false end end return type(OppGainedAff)=='function' end local function allowed(who) return tracking_ready() and who and who~='' and same(who,current()) and (not core() or core().target_valid(who)) and type(OppGainedAff)=='function' end local function score(aff) return tonumber(affstrack.score[aff]) or 0 end local function gain(aff) OppGainedAff(aff) end local function flame(kind) if type(ak.flameon)=='function' then ak.flameon(kind or 'additive') end end local function confirm_min(aff,value) affstrack.score[aff]=math.max(score(aff),value) if ak.scoreup then ak.scoreup(current()) end end local function timed(aff,who,seconds) local scores=affstrack.score -- AK's generic blisters gain installs a target-global string timer. Keep the -- confirmed score, but use the target-safe callback below for this event. if aff=='blisters' then confirm_min(aff,100) else gain(aff) end local token={} T.expiries[aff]=token if type(tempTimer)=='function' then tempTimer(seconds,function() if T.expiries[aff]~=token then return end T.expiries[aff]=nil if allowed(who) and affstrack.score==scores and type(OppLostAff)=='function' then OppLostAff(aff) end end) end end local simple = { transfix='transfixed', bombard='clumsiness', mudslide='prone slickness', asthma='asthma', sensitivity='sensitivity', healthleech='healthleech', frostbite='frostbite', stuttering='stuttering', anorexia='nausea anorexia', paralysis='paralysis', hypothermia='hypothermia', freeze='frozen', dehydrate_dry='nausea weariness', dehydrate_freeze='frozen nausea weariness', lightning_stupidity='stupidity', plague='leftleg rightleg prone', } function T.handle(event,who,detail) -- Every named cast starts a new erosion sequence, including casts aimed at -- another victim. Such a start must invalidate our previous attribution. if event=='erode_start' then T.erode=nil end if (event=='conflagrate' or event=='conflagrate_tick') and tracking_ready() and ak.limbs and type(ak.limbs.ParseonLine)=='function' then ak.limbs.ParseonLine() end -- These first-person cast responses consume our resonance even if the user -- changed target before the named victim's confirmation arrived. local plane=event:match('^emanation_(%a+)$') if plane and tracking_ready() and ak.magi and ak.magi.resonance then ak.magi.resonance[plane:sub(1,1):upper()..plane:sub(2)]=0 end -- Erosion's second line has a defence, not a victim. Attribute it only to a -- recent named first line; arbitrary follow-up text never drops a shield. if event=='erode_result' then local pending=T.erode T.erode=nil if not pending or now()-pending.at>2.5 or not same(pending.target,current()) then return false end who=pending.target end -- The unnamed room result establishes no particular enemy's cold stage. if event=='deepfreeze' then T.last_room_event={event=event,at=now()}; return true end if not allowed(who) then return false end T.last_event={event=event,target=who,at=now()} if simple[event] then if (event=='mudslide' or event=='plague') and type(EchoForMajorAff)=='function' then EchoForMajorAff('PRONE') end gain(simple[event]); return true end if event=='dehydrate_attempt' or event=='conflagrate_fail' then return true -- An attempt/failure is not evidence of an applied affliction. elseif event=='dehydrate_burning' then gain('weariness'); flame() elseif event=='fulminate' then gain(score('fulminated')<100 and 'fulminated' or score('epilepsy')<100 and 'epilepsy' or 'paralysis') elseif event=='magma' then timed('scalded',who,20) elseif event=='fire_moderate' then if score('scalded')<100 then timed('scalded',who,20) else flame() end elseif event=='blisters' then if score('blisters')>=100 then flame() else timed('blisters',who,20) end elseif event=='fire_major_burning' or event=='firelash' or event=='scintilla_burning' then flame() elseif event=='limb_break' then local limb=tostring(detail or ''):lower():gsub('%s+','') if limb=='leftarm' or limb=='rightarm' or limb=='leftleg' or limb=='rightleg' then gain(limb) else return false end elseif event:match('^emanation_') then if plane=='air' then gain('paralysis dizziness') elseif plane=='water' then gain('frozen disrupt') -- Stuttering belongs to Water's separate icicle proc. elseif plane=='fire' then flame('emanation') elseif plane=='earth' then -- AK lacks a torso calcification cure model. Keep named evidence, never -- fabricate calcifiedhead or an uncureable calcifiedtorso score. T.observed[who:lower()]=T.observed[who:lower()] or {} T.observed[who:lower()].calcifiedtorso_at=now() end elseif event=='conflagrate' or event=='conflagrate_tick' then -- Two burn levels are required to APPLY it. An ongoing tick proves only -- one remains; the victim may have cured a level since the initial cast. confirm_min('aflame',event=='conflagrate' and 200 or 100); gain('conflagrate') elseif event=='immolation' then T.observed[who:lower()]=T.observed[who:lower()] or {} T.observed[who:lower()].scintilla_until=now()+4 elseif event=='unblind' then if type(OppLostAff)=='function' then OppLostAff('blind') end elseif event=='erode_start' then T.erode={target=who,at=now()} elseif event=='erode_result' then local defence=tostring(detail or ''):lower() if not defence:match('^%a+$') then return false end ak.defs=ak.defs or {} ak.defs[defence]=false if defence=='shield' then if ak.defs.shield_by_target then ak.defs.shield_by_target[who:lower()]=false end if Yso.shield and Yso.shield.set then Yso.shield.set(who,false,'line:erode') end end elseif event=='dissonance_escalation' then local D=Yso.magi.dissonance if D and D.note and D.snapshot then local stage=math.min(4,math.max(2,(D.snapshot(who).stage or 0)+1)) D.note(who,'tracked',{stage=stage,confidence='high',evidence='named_dissonance_hum'}) end -- Existing vibration notice alone increments Convergence's tick count. else return false end return true end return T

Script.name: Magi water group
Script.script:
-- gwater: one file. Edit SETTINGS and GIVING ORDER; the first matching rule wins. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.off = Yso.off or {} Yso.off.magi = Yso.off.magi or {} local M = Yso.off.magi.water_group or {} Yso.off.magi.water_group = M M.key, M.name, M.alias_owned = 'magi_water_group', 'Magi Water Group', true
-- SETTINGS M.cfg = { loop_delay = 0.15, echo = true, pending_s = 1.0, execute_hp = 20, confirmed_score = 100, shivering_score = 200, -- AK cold ladder: 100 includes stripped insulation. frozen_score = 300, allow_hypothermia = (Yso.magi and Yso.magi.spell_feedback and Yso.magi.spell_feedback.hypothermia_tracking == true) or false, }
-- GIVING ORDER: each line below is checked from top to bottom on every attack. -- This is a priority list, not a fixed rotation. Return one full command. function M.choose(s) local target = s.target -- 1. Shield -> Erode. if s.shield then return 'cast erode at '..target..' shield', 'defense_break', 'shielded' end -- 2. Shared finishers: Destroy/Assess first, otherwise Convergence. if s.special or s.special_hold then return s.special, 'special', s.special_reason end -- 3. Target HP at or below execute_hp -> Stormhammer. if s.hp and s.hp <= M.cfg.execute_hp then return 'cast stormhammer at '..target, 'execute', 'hp_stormhammer' end -- 4. Fully frozen + Hypothermia + Water/Air at least 2 -> Glaciate. if s.frozen and s.hypothermia and s.water >= 2 and s.air >= 2 then return 'cast glaciate at '..target, 'glaciate_burst', 'glaciate_ready' end -- 5. At least shivering and Waterbonds missing -> staff cast Horripilation. if (s.shivering or s.frozen) and not s.waterbonds then return 'staff cast horripilation at '..target, 'waterbonds_setup', 'waterbonds_missing_cold' end -- 6. Scalded missing and Earth 0 -> Pebble. if not s.scalded and s.earth == 0 then return 'cast pebble at '..target, 'earth_setup', 'scalded_missing_earth0' end -- 7. Fully frozen, Hypothermia missing, Water/Air at least 2 -> Hypothermia. if M.cfg.allow_hypothermia and s.frozen and not s.hypothermia and s.water >= 2 and s.air >= 2 then return 'cast hypothermia at '..target, 'freeze_setup', 'hypothermia_missing' end -- 8. Water below 2 -> Dehydrate. if s.water < 2 then return 'cast dehydrate at '..target, 'resonance_build', 'build_water' end -- 9. Shivering + nausea without weariness -> Dehydrate; otherwise Freeze. if s.shivering then if s.nausea and not s.weariness then return 'cast dehydrate at '..target, 'freeze_setup', 'shiver_nausea' end return 'cast freeze at '..target, 'freeze_setup', 'shivering' end -- 10. Air below 2 -> Bombard if Earth is below 2; otherwise Fulminate. if s.air < 2 then if s.earth < 2 then return 'cast bombard at '..target, 'resonance_build', 'build_air_earth' end return 'cast fulminate at '..target, 'resonance_build', 'build_air_fire' end -- 11. Not fully frozen -> Freeze. if not s.frozen then return 'cast freeze at '..target, 'freeze_setup', 'build_cold' end -- 12. Earth at least 3 -> Earth Emanation. if s.earth >= 3 then return 'cast emanation at '..target..' earth', 'earth_promotion', 'earth_major' end -- 13. Water at least 3 -> Water Emanation. if s.water >= 3 then return 'cast emanation at '..target..' water', 'water_promotion', 'water_major' end -- 14. Slickness missing -> Mudslide. if not s.slickness then return 'cast mudslide at '..target, 'salve_pressure', 'slickness_missing' end -- 15. Fire below 2 -> Fulminate. if s.fire < 2 then return 'cast fulminate at '..target, 'kelp_pressure', 'build_fire' end -- 16. Otherwise -> Dehydrate. return 'cast dehydrate at '..target, 'disrupt_setup', 'water_pressure' end
-- INPUTS AND ROUTE CHECKS Yso.off.magi.route_core = Yso.off.magi.route_core or {} local RC = Yso.off.magi.route_core local RI = Yso.Combat and Yso.Combat.RouteInterface M.state = M.state or {} M.route_contract = { id=M.key, interface_version=1, shared_categories={'defense_break'}, route_local_categories={'execute','water_group'}, capabilities={uses_eq=true,uses_bal=false,uses_entity=false,supports_burst=true,supports_bootstrap=false,needs_target=true}, override_policy={mode='narrow_global_only',allowed={target_invalid=true,target_slain=true,route_off=true, pause=true,manual_suppression=true,target_swap_bootstrap=true}}, } if RI and RI.ensure_hooks then RI.ensure_hooks(M,M.route_contract) end local function ready() return type(RC.get_target)=='function' and type(RC.mark_pending)=='function' end local function is_magi() local check=Yso.is_magi or (Yso.classinfo and Yso.classinfo.is_magi) or (Yso.magi and Yso.magi.defs and Yso.magi.defs.is_magi) if type(check)~='function' then return false end local ok,value=pcall(check) return ok and value==true end local function notify(message) if M.cfg.echo and type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<cadet_blue>[Yso:Magi] <reset>'..message..'\n') end end function M.init() M.state.loop_delay=M.cfg.loop_delay M.state.pending=M.state.pending or {} M.state.template=M.state.template or {} if RI and RI.ensure_waiting_state then RI.ensure_waiting_state(M.state,M.key) end return true end function M.clear_runtime() M.init() M.state.submission,M.state.pending=nil,{} M.state.last_sent_cmd,M.state.last_sent_target,M.state.last_sent_at='','',0 if RI and RI.clear_waiting then RI.clear_waiting(M.state,M.key) end return true end function M.is_enabled() return M.state.enabled==true end function M.is_active() if not is_magi() or not (Yso.mode and Yso.mode.is_combat and Yso.mode.is_combat()) then return false end if Yso.mode.route_loop_active then return Yso.mode.route_loop_active(M.key)==true end return M.state.loop_enabled==true end function M.can_run(ctx) M.init() ctx=type(ctx)=='table' and ctx or {} if not ready() then return false,'core_unavailable' end if not M.is_enabled() then return false,'disabled' end if not M.is_active() then return false,'inactive' end if Yso.offense_paused and Yso.offense_paused() then if not ctx.preview then M.clear_runtime() end return false,'paused' end local target=RC.trim(ctx.target or RC.get_target()) if target=='' then return false,'no_target' end if not RC.same_target(target,RC.get_target()) then return false,'target_mismatch' end if not RC.target_valid(target) then return false,'invalid_target' end if not RC.eq_ready() then return false,'eq_down' end return true,target end function M.snapshot(target) local r,score=RC.read_resonance(),RC.score_aff local cold=score('frozen') local defs=(rawget(_G,'ak') or {}).defs or {} local shield=defs.shield if defs.shield_by_target then shield=defs.shield_by_target[target:lower()] end if Yso.shield and Yso.shield.up then shield=Yso.shield.up(target:lower()) end local special,reason,hold=RC.special_action(target) return {target=target,hp=RC.get_target_hp_percent(target),shield=shield==true, air=r.air,earth=r.earth,fire=r.fire,water=r.water, frozen=cold>=M.cfg.frozen_score,shivering=cold>=M.cfg.shivering_score and cold<M.cfg.frozen_score, waterbonds=score('waterbonds')>=M.cfg.confirmed_score, hypothermia=score('hypothermia')>=M.cfg.confirmed_score,nausea=score('nausea')>=M.cfg.confirmed_score, weariness=score('weariness')>=M.cfg.confirmed_score,slickness=score('slickness')>=M.cfg.confirmed_score, scalded=score('scalded')>=M.cfg.confirmed_score,special=special,special_reason=reason,special_hold=hold} end
-- SENDING: one reservation covers the send-to-ack gap; spell windows prevent repeats. local function last_ack() return Yso._last_eq_ack_payload or (Yso.queue and Yso.queue._last_ack_payload) end local function flight(target,preview) local sub=M.state.submission if sub and (not RC.same_target(sub.target,target) or RC.now()>=sub.until_t) then if not preview then M.clear_runtime() end return nil end return sub end function M.attack_function(arg) local ctx=type(arg)=='table' and arg or {} if ready() then RC.entourage_sync(M,ctx.target or RC.get_target(),is_magi(),ctx.preview) end local ok,target=M.can_run(ctx) if not ok then return false,target end local sub=flight(target,ctx.preview) if sub and not sub.acknowledged then local reason=sub.slot..'_pending' if not ctx.preview then M.state.template.last_reason=reason end return false,reason end local command,category,reason=M.choose(M.snapshot(target)) if not ctx.preview then M.state.template.last_reason,M.state.template.last_target=reason,target end if not command then return false,reason end local slot=command:match('^cast%s+(%S+)') or command:match('^staff%s+cast%s+(%S+)') or 'eq' local pending=M.state.pending[slot] if pending and RC.same_target(pending.target,target) and RC.now()<pending.until_t then if not ctx.preview then M.state.template.last_reason=slot..'_pending' end return false,slot..'_pending' end local payload={target=target,eq=command,lanes={eq=command},meta={main_lane='eq',main_category=category,main_reason=reason}} if ctx.preview then return payload end if Yso.magi and Yso.magi.weapons and Yso.magi.weapons.send_wields then Yso.magi.weapons.send_wields() end sub={cmd=command,target=target,slot=slot,until_t=RC.now()+M.cfg.pending_s,emitting=true,previous_eq_ack=last_ack()} M.state.submission=sub -- Reserve before emit: acknowledgements may be synchronous. if RI and RI.mark_waiting then RI.mark_waiting(M.state,M.key,payload,{main_lane='eq'}) end local opts={route=M.key,target=target,kind='offense',commit=true,reason=M.key..':'..category} local sent,detail,ack if RI and RI.emit_route_payload then sent,detail,ack=RI.emit_route_payload(M.key,payload,opts) elseif type(Yso.emit)=='function' then sent=Yso.emit(payload,opts);ack=payload end sub.emitting,sub.payload=false,ack if sent~=true then M.clear_runtime();return false,detail or 'emit_failed' end RC.mark_pending(M.state,slot,target,M.cfg.pending_s) RC.note_special_queued(command,target) local bus=Yso.locks and Yso.locks.note_payload and Yso.queue and Yso.queue.commit if not bus or (Yso.net and Yso.net.cfg and Yso.net.cfg.dry_run) then M.on_payload_sent(ack or payload) end M.state.last_cmd,M.state.last_category,M.state.last_target=command,category,target return true,command end function M.on_payload_sent(payload) M.init() if type(payload)~='table' then return false end if RI and RI.payload_has_any_route and RI.payload_has_any_route(payload) and not RI.payload_has_route(payload,M.key) then return false end local lanes=payload.lanes or payload local command=lanes.eq or payload.eq if not command and not payload.lanes and not (payload.bal or payload.free or payload.class or payload.ent or payload.entity) then command=payload.cmd end local sub=M.state.submission local target=RC.trim(payload.target or RC.get_target()) if not sub or RC.trim(command)~=sub.cmd or not RC.same_target(target,sub.target) then return false end local latest=last_ack() if not sub.emitting and payload~=sub.payload and (payload~=latest or latest==sub.previous_eq_ack) then return false end sub.acknowledged,sub.ack_payload,sub.until_t,sub.eq_ack=true,payload,RC.now()+M.cfg.pending_s,latest RC.mark_pending(M.state,sub.slot,target,M.cfg.pending_s) if RI and RI.clear_waiting then RI.clear_waiting(M.state,M.key) end return true end M.on_payload_queued=M.on_payload_sent function M.on_send_result(payload,ctx) local sub=M.state.submission if not sub or type(payload)~='table' then return false end if ctx and ctx.success==false and (payload==sub.payload or payload==sub.ack_payload) then M.clear_runtime() end return true end function M.on_resonance_failure(required,element) if not ready() then return false end local sub=flight(RC.get_target()) if not sub or not sub.acknowledged or last_ack()~=sub.eq_ack then return false end local plane=sub.cmd:match('^cast emanation at %S+ (%a+)$') if (plane==element and required==3) or ((sub.slot=='glaciate' or sub.slot=='hypothermia') and required==2 and (element=='air' or element=='water')) then return M.clear_runtime() end return false end
-- LOOP LIFECYCLE M.alias_loop_stop_details={inactive=true,disabled=true,no_target=true,invalid_target=true,wrong_class=true,core_unavailable=true} function M.alias_loop_prepare_start(ctx) M.clear_runtime();return ctx or {} end function M.alias_loop_on_started() M.clear_runtime() if ready() then RC.entourage_sync(M,RC.get_target(),is_magi()) end notify('Water group loop ON.') end function M.alias_loop_on_stopped(ctx) M.clear_runtime() if RC.entourage_passive then RC.entourage_passive(M) end ctx=ctx or {} M.state.template.last_disable_reason=ctx.reason or 'manual' if not ctx.silent then notify('Water group loop OFF ('..M.state.template.last_disable_reason..').') end end function M.alias_loop_waiting_blocks() if not ready() then return false end if Yso.offense_paused and Yso.offense_paused() then M.clear_runtime();return false end local sub=flight(RC.get_target()) return sub~=nil and not sub.acknowledged end M.alias_loop_clear_waiting=M.clear_runtime M.on_target_swap=M.clear_runtime M.on_pause=M.clear_runtime function M.alias_loop_on_error(err) notify('Water group loop error: '..tostring(err)) end function M.on_exit() M.clear_runtime() if RC.entourage_passive then RC.entourage_passive(M) end if Yso.mode and Yso.mode.stop_route_loop then Yso.mode.stop_route_loop(M.key,'exit',true) end return true end function M.evaluate(ctx) return M.attack_function({preview=true,target=type(ctx)=='table' and ctx.target or nil}) end function M.explain() if not ready() then return {reason='core_unavailable'} end local s=M.snapshot(RC.get_target()) s.command,s.category,s.reason=M.choose(s) s.allow_hypothermia=M.cfg.allow_hypothermia return s end M.clear_runtime() if Yso.off.core and Yso.off.core.register then Yso.off.core.register(M.key,M) end return M

Script.name: Magi elemental helpers
Script.script:
Yso = Yso or {} Yso.magi = Yso.magi or {} Yso.magi.elemental = Yso.magi.elemental or {}
local M = Yso.magi.elemental
M.cfg = M.cfg or {} M.cfg.destroy = M.cfg.destroy or { require_conflagration = true, hp_threshold = 40, enforce_hp_gate = true, }
M.state = M.state or {} M.state.timers = M.state.timers or {} M.state.destroy_hp_stub_noted = M.state.destroy_hp_stub_noted or false
local function _now() local t = (type(getEpoch) == "function" and tonumber(getEpoch())) or os.time() if t and t > 1000000000000 then t = t / 1000 end return t or os.time() end
local function _echo(msg) if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho(string.format("<SlateBlue>[Magi] <white>%s\n", tostring(msg))) end end
local function _trim(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end
local function _resolve_current_target() local tgt = ""
if Yso and type(Yso.get_target) == "function" then local ok, res = pcall(Yso.get_target) if ok and type(res) == "string" then tgt = _trim(res) end end
if tgt == "" and Yso and Yso.targeting and type(Yso.targeting.get) == "function" then local ok, res = pcall(Yso.targeting.get) if ok and type(res) == "string" then tgt = _trim(res) end end
if tgt == "" then tgt = _trim(rawget(_G, "target")) end
tgt = tostring(tgt or ""):gsub("%s*%b()%s*$", "") return _trim(tgt) end
local function _queue_eqbal(cmd, opts) opts = opts or {} cmd = _trim(cmd) if cmd == "" or type(send) ~= "function" then return false end
if tostring(opts.queue_verb or ""):lower() == "addclearfull" then if Yso and Yso.queue and type(Yso.queue.addclearfull) == "function" then return Yso.queue.addclearfull("eqbal", cmd) == true end send("queue addclearfull eqbal " .. cmd, false) return true end
send("queue prepend eqbal " .. cmd, false) return true end
local function _target_has_aff(aff) aff = _trim(aff):lower() if aff == "" then return false end
if Yso and Yso.ak and type(Yso.ak.has) == "function" then local ok, has_aff = pcall(Yso.ak.has, aff) if ok then return has_aff == true end end
local threshold = tonumber(Yso and Yso.ak and Yso.ak.threshold) or 100 if type(affstrack) == "table" and type(affstrack.score) == "table" then return (tonumber(affstrack.score[aff] or 0) or 0) >= threshold end
return false end
local function _record_timer(spell, seconds) M.state.timers[spell] = { seconds = tonumber(seconds) or 0, armed_at = _now(), } end
function M.get_target_hp_percent(_target_name) local RC = Yso and Yso.off and Yso.off.magi and Yso.off.magi.route_core if type(RC) == "table" and type(RC.get_target_hp_percent) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(RC.get_target_hp_percent, _target_name) if ok and tonumber(v) then return tonumber(v) end end return nil end
function M.firelash(mode) local arg = _trim(mode):lower() local target = arg
if target == "" then target = _resolve_current_target() end
if target == "" then _echo("No target set for firelash.") return false end
local ok = _queue_eqbal("cast firelash at " .. target) if ok then _echo("Firelash queued at " .. target .. ".") end return ok end
function M.destroy_current_target() local tgt = _resolve_current_target() local C = Yso.magi and Yso.magi.convergence if not C or type(C.destroy_command) ~= "function" then _echo("Destroy blocked: shared finisher helper unavailable.") return false end local cmd, why = C.destroy_command(tgt) if not cmd then _echo("Destroy blocked: " .. tostring(why)) return false end local ok = false if type(Yso.emit) == "function" then ok = Yso.emit({ eq=cmd, target=tgt }, { route="magi_destroy", target=tgt, kind="offense", commit=true, reason="magi_destroy:" .. tostring(why), }) == true elseif type(send) == "function" then local sent, result = pcall(send, "queue addclearfull eq " .. cmd, false) ok = sent and result ~= false end if ok then C.note_queued(cmd, tgt) end return ok end local function _cast_timed_spell(spell, seconds) local secs = tonumber(seconds) if not secs then _echo(string.format("%s requires a timer between 10 and 60 seconds.", tostring(spell))) return false end
secs = math.floor(secs) if secs < 10 or secs > 60 then _echo(string.format("%s requires a timer between 10 and 60 seconds.", tostring(spell))) return false end
local ok = _queue_eqbal(string.format("cast %s %d", tostring(spell), secs)) if ok then _record_timer(spell, secs) _echo(string.format("%s armed for %ds.", tostring(spell):gsub("^%l", string.upper), secs)) end return ok end
function M.cast_holocaust(seconds) return _cast_timed_spell("holocaust", seconds) end
function M.cast_magmasphere(seconds) return _cast_timed_spell("magmasphere", seconds) end

Script.name: Magi route core
Script.script:
--========================================================-- -- Magi route chassis helpers -- * Shared runtime helpers for Magi route modules. -- * Keeps targeting, timing, pending windows, and snapshots in one place. --========================================================--
Yso = Yso or {} Yso.off = Yso.off or {} Yso.off.magi = Yso.off.magi or {}
Yso.off.magi.route_core = Yso.off.magi.route_core or {} local RC = Yso.off.magi.route_core
function RC.trim(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end
function RC.lc(s) return RC.trim(s):lower() end
function RC.same_target(a, b) a = RC.lc(a) b = RC.lc(b) return a ~= "" and a == b end
function RC.now() if Yso and Yso.util and type(Yso.util.now) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(Yso.util.now) if ok and tonumber(v) then return tonumber(v) end end if type(getEpoch) == "function" then local v = tonumber(getEpoch()) or os.time() if v > 20000000000 then v = v / 1000 end return v end return os.time() end
function RC.get_target() if type(Yso.get_target) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(Yso.get_target) if ok and RC.trim(v) ~= "" then return RC.trim(v) end end
-- Yso.targeting subsystem (checked before global fallbacks so the routing -- system agrees with whatever Magi_duel_dam.lua and other alias files see). if type(Yso.targeting) == "table" then if type(Yso.targeting.get) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(Yso.targeting.get) if ok and RC.trim(v) ~= "" then return RC.trim(v) end elseif type(Yso.targeting.get_target) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(Yso.targeting.get_target) if ok and RC.trim(v) ~= "" then return RC.trim(v) end elseif type(Yso.targeting.target) == "string" then local v = RC.trim(Yso.targeting.target) if v ~= "" then return v end end end
local cur = rawget(_G, "target") if type(cur) == "string" and RC.trim(cur) ~= "" then return RC.trim(cur) end
local ak = rawget(_G, "ak") if type(ak) == "table" then if type(ak.target) == "string" and RC.trim(ak.target) ~= "" then return RC.trim(ak.target) end if type(ak.tgt) == "string" and RC.trim(ak.tgt) ~= "" then return RC.trim(ak.tgt) end end
return "" end
function RC.room_id() local g = rawget(_G, "gmcp") local info = g and g.Room and g.Room.Info if info and info.num ~= nil then return tostring(info.num) end if info and info.id ~= nil then return tostring(info.id) end return "" end
function RC.target_valid(tgt) tgt = RC.trim(tgt) if tgt == "" then return false end if type(Yso.target_is_valid) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(Yso.target_is_valid, tgt) if ok then return v == true end end return true end
-- Pet orders have no BAL/EQ cost and must stay outside spell queue/pending gates. -- Keep this state on the reused core so reloading the Focus alias does not spam. RC.entourage = RC.entourage or {} local function entourage_dispatch(command) if Yso.net and Yso.net.cfg and Yso.net.cfg.dry_run == true then return false end if type(Yso.send) == "function" then local ok, result = pcall(Yso.send, command) return ok and result == true end if type(send) ~= "function" then return false end local ok, result = pcall(send, command, false) return ok and result ~= false end
function RC.entourage_sync(route, target, is_magi, preview) if preview or not is_magi then return false end local pause=Yso.Combat and Yso.Combat.Pause if pause and pause.blocked(route.key) then return false end if not route.is_enabled() or not route.is_active() then return false end if type(Yso.offense_paused) == "function" and Yso.offense_paused() then return false end target = RC.trim(target) if not target:match("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'%-]*$") or not RC.target_valid(target) then return false end if Yso.net and Yso.net.cfg and Yso.net.cfg.dry_run == true then return false end local E = RC.entourage if E.owner == route and RC.same_target(E.target, target) then return true end -- Dispatch may throw after transmitting; still allow stop cleanup in that case. E.owner, E.needs_passive, E.target = route, true, nil if not entourage_dispatch("order entourage kill " .. target) then return false end E.target = target return true end
function RC.entourage_passive(route) local E = RC.entourage if E.owner ~= route or not E.needs_passive then return true end if not entourage_dispatch("order entourage passive") then return false end E.owner, E.target, E.needs_passive = nil, nil, false return true end
function RC.eq_ready() if Yso and Yso.locks and type(Yso.locks.eq_ready) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(Yso.locks.eq_ready) if ok then return v == true end end if Yso and Yso.state and type(Yso.state.eq_ready) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(Yso.state.eq_ready) if ok then return v == true end end
local vitals = (rawget(_G, "gmcp") or {}).Char vitals = vitals and vitals.Vitals or {} local eq_val = vitals.eq if eq_val == nil then eq_val = vitals.equilibrium end if eq_val == nil then eq_val = "" end return tostring(eq_val) == "1" or eq_val == true end
function RC.score_aff(aff) aff = RC.lc(aff) if aff == "" then return 0 end
if Yso and Yso.oc and Yso.oc.ak and type(Yso.oc.ak.get_aff_score) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(Yso.oc.ak.get_aff_score, aff) if ok and tonumber(v) then return tonumber(v) end end
local A = rawget(_G, "affstrack") if type(A) == "table" and type(A.score) == "table" then local row = A.score[aff] if type(row) == "number" then return tonumber(row) or 0 end if type(row) == "table" then return tonumber(row.current or row.score or row.value or 0) or 0 end end
if Yso and Yso.ak and type(Yso.ak.has) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(Yso.ak.has, aff) if ok and v == true then return 100 end end
return 0 end
function RC.has_aff(aff) return RC.score_aff(aff) > 0 end
function RC.get_target_hp_percent(_target_name) local C = Yso.magi and Yso.magi.convergence if C and type(C.hp) == "function" then return C.hp(_target_name or RC.get_target()) end local ak = rawget(_G, "ak") if type(ak) == "table" then local pct = tonumber(ak.healthpercent) if pct then return pct end local cur = tonumber(ak.currenthealth) local maxhp = tonumber(ak.maxhealth) if cur and maxhp and maxhp > 0 then return (cur / maxhp) * 100 end end
local gmcp = rawget(_G, "gmcp") local info = gmcp and gmcp.IRE and gmcp.IRE.Target and gmcp.IRE.Target.Info if type(info) == "table" then local raw = info.hpperc if raw ~= nil and tostring(raw) ~= "-1" then local hp_text = tostring(raw):gsub("%%", "") local n = tonumber(hp_text) if n then return n end end end
local assess = tonumber(Yso and Yso.magi_assess) if assess then return assess end return nil end
Yso.magi = Yso.magi or {} Yso.magi.elemental = Yso.magi.elemental or {} Yso.magi.elemental.get_target_hp_percent = RC.get_target_hp_percent
function RC.read_resonance() local R = Yso and Yso.magi and Yso.magi.resonance or nil local ak = rawget(_G, "ak") local live = ak and ak.magi and ak.magi.resonance or nil local synced = false local out = { air = 0, earth = 0, fire = 0, water = 0, synced = false }
if type(R) == "table" and type(R.sync_from_ak) == "function" then local ok, synced_ok = pcall(R.sync_from_ak) if ok then synced = (synced_ok == true) end end
local function _get(element) if type(R) == "table" and type(R.get) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(R.get, element) if ok then return tonumber(v) or 0 end end if type(R) == "table" and type(R.state) == "table" then return tonumber(R.state[element] or 0) or 0 end -- AK's package triggers are available even when the optional skill -- reference/runtime helper is not installed. if type(live) == "table" then local upper = element:sub(1, 1):upper() .. element:sub(2) return tonumber(live[upper] or live[element] or 0) or 0 end return 0 end
out.air = _get("air") out.earth = _get("earth") out.fire = _get("fire") out.water = _get("water") out.synced = synced or (type(R) ~= "table" and type(live) == "table") out.air_moderate = out.air >= 2 out.earth_moderate = out.earth >= 2 out.fire_moderate = out.fire >= 2 out.water_moderate = out.water >= 2 out.air_major = out.air >= 3 out.earth_major = out.earth >= 3 out.fire_major = out.fire >= 3 out.water_major = out.water >= 3 return out end
function RC.ensure_pending(state, slots) state.pending = state.pending or {} if type(slots) ~= "table" then return state.pending end for i = 1, #slots do local name = tostring(slots[i] or "") if name ~= "" then state.pending[name] = state.pending[name] or { target = "", until_t = 0 } end end return state.pending end
function RC.pending_slot(state, slot) slot = tostring(slot or "") if slot == "" then return nil end RC.ensure_pending(state, { slot }) return state.pending[slot] end
function RC.clear_pending(state, slot) local row = RC.pending_slot(state, slot) if not row then return nil end row.target = "" row.until_t = 0 return row end
function RC.clear_pending_all(state, slots) if type(slots) ~= "table" then return true end for i = 1, #slots do RC.clear_pending(state, slots[i]) end return true end
function RC.mark_pending(state, slot, target, duration) local row = RC.pending_slot(state, slot) if not row then return nil end row.target = RC.trim(target) row.until_t = RC.now() + (tonumber(duration) or 0) return row end
function RC.pending_active(state, slot, target) local row = RC.pending_slot(state, slot) if not row then return false end return RC.same_target(row.target, target) and RC.now() < (tonumber(row.until_t) or 0) end
function RC.same_target_repeat(state, cmd, target, repeat_s) state = type(state) == "table" and state or {} if not RC.same_target(state.last_sent_target or "", target) then return false end if RC.lc(state.last_sent_cmd or "") ~= RC.lc(cmd or "") then return false end local dt = RC.now() - (tonumber(state.last_sent_at) or 0) return dt >= 0 and dt < (tonumber(repeat_s) or 0.75) end
function RC.guard_spell(opts) opts = type(opts) == "table" and opts or {} local state = type(opts.state) == "table" and opts.state or {} local target = RC.trim(opts.target) local slot = tostring(opts.slot or "") local cmd = tostring(opts.cmd or "")
if target == "" then return false, "no_target" end
local target_valid = opts.target_valid if target_valid == nil then target_valid = RC.target_valid(target) end if target_valid ~= true then return false, "invalid_target" end
if opts.eq_required ~= false then local eq_ready = opts.eq_ready if eq_ready == nil then eq_ready = RC.eq_ready() end if eq_ready ~= true then return false, "eq_down" end end
if slot ~= "" and RC.pending_active(state, slot, target) then return false, slot .. "_pending" end
if RC.same_target_repeat(state, cmd, target, opts.repeat_s or (opts.cfg and opts.cfg.same_target_repeat_s) or 0.75) then return false, (slot ~= "" and (slot .. "_repeat") or "repeat") end
return true, "" end
function RC.build_snapshot(opts) opts = type(opts) == "table" and opts or {} local target = RC.trim(opts.target or RC.get_target()) local tv = opts.target_valid if tv == nil then tv = RC.target_valid(target) end local eq = opts.eq_ready if eq == nil then eq = RC.eq_ready() end local out = { target = target, room_id = tostring(opts.room_id or RC.room_id() or ""), target_valid = tv, eq_ready = eq, raw = {}, pending = {}, res = RC.read_resonance(), }
local affs = type(opts.affs) == "table" and opts.affs or {} for i = 1, #affs do local aff = tostring(affs[i] or "") if aff ~= "" then out.raw[aff] = RC.score_aff(aff) out[aff] = out.raw[aff] > 0 end end
local pending_slots = type(opts.pending_slots) == "table" and opts.pending_slots or {} for i = 1, #pending_slots do local slot = tostring(pending_slots[i] or "") if slot ~= "" then out.pending[slot] = RC.pending_active(opts.state or {}, slot, target) end end
if type(opts.extend) == "function" then opts.extend(out) end
return out end
function RC.build_explain(base) local out = {} if type(base) == "table" then for k, v in pairs(base) do out[k] = v end end out.generated_at = RC.now() return out end
function RC.reset_runtime_state(state, reason) state = type(state) == "table" and state or {} reason = tostring(reason or "manual") state.busy = false state.last_target = "" state.last_cmd = "" state.last_category = "" state.last_sent_cmd = "" state.last_sent_target = "" state.last_sent_category = "" state.last_sent_at = 0 state.explain = {} state.template = state.template or {} state.template.last_reason = reason state.template.last_payload = nil state.template.last_target = "" return state end
-- Optional shared finishers are resolved at call time (native load order). function RC.special_action(tgt) local C = Yso.magi and Yso.magi.convergence if C and type(C.select) == "function" then return C.select(tgt) end return nil, "special_helper_unavailable" end
function RC.note_special_queued(cmd, tgt) local C = Yso.magi and Yso.magi.convergence if C and type(C.note_queued) == "function" then C.note_queued(cmd, tgt) end end
-- Remove obsolete automatic-purge state and functions when reloading a reused core. RC.bloodboil = nil RC.bloodboil_note_cast = nil RC.bloodboil_note_ready = nil RC.bloodboil_note_eq_recovered = nil RC.bloodboil_command = nil RC.with_bloodboil = nil
return RC

Script.name: Magi focus
Script.script:
--========================================================-- -- Magi dissonance tracker -- * Lightweight local inference for the Focus route. -- * Tracks estimated stage, confidence, and last evidence by target. --========================================================--
Yso = Yso or {} Yso.magi = Yso.magi or {} Yso.magi.dissonance = Yso.magi.dissonance or {}
local D = Yso.magi.dissonance
D.state = D.state or { by_target = {}, }
local function _trim(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end
local function _lc(s) return _trim(s):lower() end
local function _now() local RC = Yso and Yso.off and Yso.off.magi and Yso.off.magi.route_core or nil if type(RC) == "table" and type(RC.now) == "function" then return RC.now() end if type(getEpoch) == "function" then local v = tonumber(getEpoch()) or os.time() if v > 20000000000 then v = v / 1000 end return v end return os.time() end
local CONF_RANK = { low = 1, medium = 2, high = 3, }
local function _merge_conf(cur, new) cur = _lc(cur) new = _lc(new) if new ~= "" and not CONF_RANK[new] and type(cecho) == "function" then cecho(string.format("<yellow>[Magi:Dissonance] <reset>Unknown confidence level '%s'; keeping current value.\n", tostring(new))) end if CONF_RANK[new] and CONF_RANK[new] > (CONF_RANK[cur] or 0) then return new end return (CONF_RANK[cur] and cur) or "low" end
local function _slot(target, create) target = _lc(target) if target == "" then return nil end local row = D.state.by_target[target] if row or create == false then return row end row = { target = target, stage = 0, confidence = "low", last_evidence = "", updated_at = 0, } D.state.by_target[target] = row return row end
local function _copy(row, target) row = row or {} return { target = _trim(target or row.target or ""), stage = tonumber(row.stage or 0) or 0, confidence = _lc(row.confidence or "low"), last_evidence = tostring(row.last_evidence or ""), updated_at = tonumber(row.updated_at or 0) or 0, } end
function D.reset() D.state.by_target = {} return true end
function D.reset_target(target) target = _lc(target) if target ~= "" then D.state.by_target[target] = nil end return true end
function D.note(target, token, opts) local row = _slot(target, true) if not row then return false end
token = _lc(token) opts = type(opts) == "table" and opts or {}
local stage = tonumber(opts.stage) local confidence = _lc(opts.confidence or "") local evidence = tostring(opts.evidence or token)
if token == "route_send" or token == "send" or token == "embed" then stage = math.min(4, math.max(row.stage or 0, (row.stage or 0) + 1)) confidence = (confidence ~= "" and confidence) or "low" elseif token == "resonance" then stage = math.max(row.stage or 0, math.max(tonumber(opts.min_stage or 1) or 1, 1)) confidence = (confidence ~= "" and confidence) or "medium" elseif token == "tracked" then stage = math.max(row.stage or 0, tonumber(opts.stage or 1) or 1) confidence = (confidence ~= "" and confidence) or "medium" elseif token == "clear" or token == "reset" then stage = 0 confidence = (confidence ~= "" and confidence) or "low" row.stage = 0 row.confidence = confidence row.last_evidence = evidence row.updated_at = _now() return true, _copy(row) end
if stage ~= nil then if stage < 0 then stage = 0 end if stage > 4 then stage = 4 end row.stage = stage end row.confidence = _merge_conf(row.confidence, confidence ~= "" and confidence or row.confidence) row.last_evidence = evidence row.updated_at = _now() return true, _copy(row) end
function D.snapshot(target) target = _trim(target) if target == "" then return _copy(nil, target) end return _copy(_slot(target, false), target) end
-- return omitted: native Focus shares Yso.magi.dissonance
--========================================================-- -- magi_focus.lua -- * Duel affliction / convergence route for Magi. -- * Mudlet-primary copy lives in ^mfocus$ alias (Magi/mfocus_alias_body.lua; includes route_core + dissonance). -- * Keeps route-local priorities local while sharing chassis helpers. --========================================================--
Yso = Yso or {} Yso.off = Yso.off or {} Yso.off.magi = Yso.off.magi or {} Yso.magi = Yso.magi or {}
Yso.off.magi.focus = Yso.off.magi.focus or {} local MF = Yso.off.magi.focus MF.alias_owned = true
Yso.off.magi.route_core = Yso.off.magi.route_core or {} local RC = Yso.off.magi.route_core
Yso.magi.dissonance = Yso.magi.dissonance or {} local Dissonance = Yso.magi.dissonance
local RI = Yso and Yso.Combat and Yso.Combat.RouteInterface or nil
local PENDING_SLOTS = { "hellfumes", "pebble", -- Conditional earth seed; confirmation comes from resonance feedback. "horripilation", --gives waterbonds "dehydrate", -- Nausea/weariness; existing weariness gives burning, otherwise existing nausea gives freeze. Never both stacks. "mudslide", -- Slickness against a frozen target. "lightning", -- Stupidity with both Shock and Lightning staff crystals fitted. "emanation", -- Spends major resonance for the selected element. "freeze", --strips insulation defence, otherwise it will give shivering, then freeze state. "bombard", --gives clumsiness "fulminate", --class mechanic. Gives fulmianted affliction. If they already have fulminated, then it gives epilepsy. If they already have epilepsy, then it gives paralysis. "firelash", "magma", "dissonance", "convergence", "destroy", }
MF.route_contract = MF.route_contract or { id = "magi_focus", interface_version = 1, shared_categories = { "defense_break", "anti_tumble" }, route_local_categories = { "opener_setup", "freeze_reopen", "resonance_progress", "fulminate_branch", "dissonance_push", "convergence_now", "postconv_finish", "maintenance", "lock_pressure", }, capabilities = { uses_eq = true, uses_bal = false, uses_entity = false, supports_burst = true, supports_bootstrap = false, needs_target = true, shares_defense_break = false, shares_anti_tumble = false, }, override_policy = { mode = "narrow_global_only", allowed = { target_invalid = true, target_slain = true, route_off = true, pause = true, manual_suppression = true, target_swap_bootstrap = true, }, }, lifecycle = { on_enter = true, on_exit = true, on_target_swap = true, on_pause = true, on_resume = true, on_manual_success = true, on_send_result = true, evaluate = true, explain = true, }, }
do local categories = MF.route_contract.route_local_categories local found = false for _, category in ipairs(categories) do if category == "lock_pressure" then found = true end end if not found then categories[#categories + 1] = "lock_pressure" end if RI and type(RI.ensure_hooks) == "function" then RI.ensure_hooks(MF, MF.route_contract) end end
MF.cfg = MF.cfg or { enabled = false, echo = true, loop_delay = 0.15, same_target_repeat_s = 0.75, hellfumes_pending_s = 1.00, pebble_pending_s = 1.00, horripilation_pending_s = 1.00, dehydrate_pending_s = 1.00, mudslide_pending_s = 1.00, lightning_pending_s = 1.00, emanation_pending_s = 2.40, shock_lightning_enabled = true, freeze_pending_s = 1.00, bombard_pending_s = 1.00, fulminate_pending_s = 1.00, firelash_pending_s = 1.00, magma_pending_s = 1.00, dissonance_pending_s = 4.00, convergence_pending_s = 1.00, destroy_pending_s = 1.00, destroy_hp_threshold = 40, destroy_require_conflagration = true, destroy_enforce_hp_gate = false, }
MF.state = MF.state or { enabled = false, loop_enabled = false, timer_id = nil, busy = false, last_target = "", last_cmd = "", last_category = "", last_sent_cmd = "", last_sent_target = "", last_sent_category = "", last_sent_at = 0, explain = {}, template = { last_reason = "init", last_disable_reason = "", last_payload = nil, last_target = "" }, pending = {}, route = { target = "", room_id = "", phase = "reset", subphase = "reset", bucket = "reset", postconv = false, last_reset_reason = "init", }, waiting = { queue = nil, main_lane = nil, lanes = nil, fingerprint = "", reason = "", at = 0 }, last_attack = { cmd = "", at = 0, target = "", main_lane = "", lanes = nil, fingerprint = "" }, in_flight = { fingerprint = "", target = "", route = "magi_focus", at = 0, resolved_at = 0, lanes = nil, eq = "", entity = "", reason = "" }, }
local function _trim(s) return RC.trim(s) end local function _lc(s) return RC.lc(s) end local function _same_target(a, b) return RC.same_target(a, b) end local function _now() return RC.now() end
local function _echo(msg) if MF.cfg.echo ~= true then return end if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho(string.format("<cadet_blue>[Yso:Magi] <reset>%s\n", tostring(msg))) elseif type(echo) == "function" then echo(string.format("[Yso:Magi] %s\n", tostring(msg))) end end
local function _current_class() local C = Yso and Yso.classinfo or nil if type(C) == "table" then if type(C.get) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(C.get) if ok and type(v) == "string" and _trim(v) ~= "" then return v end end if type(C.current_class) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(C.current_class) if ok and type(v) == "string" and _trim(v) ~= "" then return v end end end
local gmcp = rawget(_G, "gmcp") local cls = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status and gmcp.Char.Status.class or nil if type(cls) == "string" and _trim(cls) ~= "" then return cls end if type(Yso.class) == "string" and _trim(Yso.class) ~= "" then return Yso.class end return "" end
local function _is_magi() if type(Yso.is_magi) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(Yso.is_magi) if ok then return v == true end end
local C = Yso and Yso.classinfo or nil if type(C) == "table" and type(C.is_magi) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(C.is_magi) if ok then return v == true end end
return _lc(_current_class()) == "magi" end
local function _target() return RC.get_target() end local function _room_id() return RC.room_id() end local function _tgt_valid(tgt) return RC.target_valid(tgt) end local function _eq_ready() return RC.eq_ready() end local function _score_positive(aff) return RC.has_aff(aff) end
local function _kelpscore() local A = rawget(_G, "affstrack") if type(A) == "table" and tonumber(A.kelpscore) then return tonumber(A.kelpscore) or 0 end return 0 end
local function _combat_focus_context_active() return _is_magi() and Yso and Yso.mode and type(Yso.mode.is_combat) == "function" and Yso.mode.is_combat() == true end
local function _route_is_active() if not _combat_focus_context_active() then return false end if Yso and Yso.mode and type(Yso.mode.route_loop_active) == "function" then if Yso.mode.route_loop_active("magi_focus") == true then return true end if Yso.mode.route_loop_active("focus") == true then return true end return false end return MF.state and MF.state.loop_enabled == true end
local function _set_loop_enabled(on) local enabled = (on == true) MF.state.enabled = enabled MF.state.loop_enabled = enabled MF.cfg.enabled = enabled end
local function _pending_slot(name) return RC.pending_slot(MF.state, name) end local function _clear_pending(name) return RC.clear_pending(MF.state, name) end local function _clear_pending_all() return RC.clear_pending_all(MF.state, PENDING_SLOTS) end local function _mark_pending(name, tgt, seconds) return RC.mark_pending(MF.state, name, tgt, seconds) end local function _pending_active(name, tgt) return RC.pending_active(MF.state, name, tgt) end
local function _spell_guard(slot_name, tgt, cmd) return RC.guard_spell({ state = MF.state, cfg = MF.cfg, slot = slot_name, target = tgt, cmd = cmd, target_valid = _tgt_valid(tgt), eq_ready = _eq_ready(), }) end
local function _route_slot() MF.state.route = MF.state.route or { target = "", room_id = "", phase = "reset", subphase = "reset", bucket = "reset", postconv = false, last_reset_reason = "init", } return MF.state.route end
local function _reset_route(reason) local route = _route_slot() route.target = "" route.room_id = "" route.phase = "reset" route.subphase = "reset" route.bucket = "reset" route.postconv = false route.opening_dehydrate_done = false route.last_reset_reason = tostring(reason or "") return route end
local function _ensure_context(tgt) local room = _room_id() local route = _route_slot() local room_changed = route.room_id ~= "" and room ~= "" and route.room_id ~= room local target_changed = route.target ~= "" and tgt ~= "" and not _same_target(route.target, tgt)
if room_changed then route = _reset_route("room_change") _clear_pending_all() elseif target_changed then route = _reset_route("target_change") _clear_pending_all() end
route.target = _trim(tgt or "") route.room_id = room return route end
local function _set_route_stage(tgt, phase, subphase, bucket) local route = _ensure_context(tgt) route.phase = tostring(phase or "") route.subphase = tostring(subphase or "") route.bucket = tostring(bucket or "") return route end
local function _set_postconv(tgt, on) local route = _ensure_context(tgt) route.postconv = (on == true) if route.postconv == true and route.phase ~= "postconv" then route.phase = "postconv" end return route end
local function _freeze_package_intact(st) return (st.frozen == true and st.frostbite == true) or st.pending.freeze == true end
local function _focus_armed() local crystal = Yso and Yso.magi and Yso.magi.crystalism or nil if type(crystal) == "table" and type(crystal.has_focus) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(crystal.has_focus) if ok then return v == true end end return false end
local function _hellfumes_up() local H = Yso and Yso.magi and Yso.magi.hellfumes if type(H) ~= "table" then return false end if type(H.is_up) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(H.is_up) if ok then return v == true end end return H.active == true end
local function _fulm_stage_from_state(st) if st.paralysis == true then return 3 end if st.epilepsy == true then return 2 end if st.fulminated == true or st.pending.fulminate == true then return 1 end return 0 end
local function _fulm_reason(st) if st.epilepsy ~= true and st.fulminated == true then return "epilepsy_missing" end if st.paralysis ~= true and st.epilepsy == true then return "paralysis_missing" end if st.fulm_stage <= 0 then return "fulminate_seed" end if st.fulm_stage == 1 then return "epilepsy_missing" end if st.fulm_stage == 2 then return "paralysis_missing" end return "fulminate_live" end
local function _destroy_aff_present(st) return st.conflagrate == true or st.conflagration == true end
local function _target_hp_percent() if Yso and Yso.magi and Yso.magi.elemental and type(Yso.magi.elemental.get_target_hp_percent) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(Yso.magi.elemental.get_target_hp_percent) if ok and tonumber(v) then return tonumber(v) end end return nil end
local function _destroy_window() if MF.cfg.destroy_enforce_hp_gate == true then local hp = _target_hp_percent() if hp == nil then return false, "hp_unknown", "unknown" end if hp > (tonumber(MF.cfg.destroy_hp_threshold or 40) or 40) then return false, "hp_window_closed", string.format("%.1f>%d", hp, tonumber(MF.cfg.destroy_hp_threshold or 40) or 40) end return true, "", string.format("%.1f<=%d", hp, tonumber(MF.cfg.destroy_hp_threshold or 40) or 40) end return true, "", "stubbed" end
local function _conv_missing(res) local out = {} if tonumber(res.air or 0) < 2 then out[#out + 1] = "air" end if tonumber(res.earth or 0) < 2 then out[#out + 1] = "earth" end if tonumber(res.fire or 0) < 2 then out[#out + 1] = "fire" end if tonumber(res.water or 0) < 2 then out[#out + 1] = "water" end return out end
local function _next_conv_gate(st) if #st.conv_missing > 0 then return "moderate:" .. table.concat(st.conv_missing, "/") end if st.dissonance_stage < 4 then return "dissonance:" .. tostring(st.dissonance_stage) end return "ready" end
local function _conv_blocker(st) if st.lock_ready ~= true then if #st.lock_missing_core > 0 then return "lock_missing:" .. table.concat(st.lock_missing_core, "/") end return "lock_mentals:" .. tostring(st.mental_count) .. "/2" end if #st.conv_missing > 0 then return "missing_moderate:" .. table.concat(st.conv_missing, "/") end if st.dissonance_stage < 4 then return "dissonance_stage_" .. tostring(st.dissonance_stage) end return "" end
local function _choose_threshold_rule(st) if st.postconv == true then return "postconv_overlay" end if st.fulminate_need == true then return "kelp_pressure_established" end if st.bombard_need == true then return st.bombard_reason end if tonumber(st.res.fire or 0) < 2 then return "fire_moderate_missing" end if st.dissonance_stage < 4 then return "dissonance_stage_" .. tostring(st.dissonance_stage) end return "maintenance" end
local function _snapshot(tgt) local base = RC.build_snapshot({ state = MF.state, target = tgt, affs = { "waterbonds", "nausea", "weariness", "frozen", "frostbite", "clumsiness", "asthma", "fulminated", "epilepsy", "paralysis", "dissonance", "conflagrate", "conflagration", "scalded", "slickness", "anorexia", "dizziness", "stupidity", "ablaze", }, pending_slots = PENDING_SLOTS, }) local route = _ensure_context(tgt) local dis = Dissonance.snapshot(tgt)
if tonumber(base.raw.dissonance or 0) > 0 and tonumber(dis.stage or 0) < 1 then Dissonance.note(tgt, "tracked", { stage = 1, confidence = "medium", evidence = "ak_dissonance" }) dis = Dissonance.snapshot(tgt) end
local st = { target = base.target, room_id = base.room_id, target_valid = base.target_valid, eq_ready = base.eq_ready, waterbonds = base.waterbonds == true or base.pending.horripilation == true, frozen = base.frozen == true, frostbite = base.frostbite == true, clumsiness = base.clumsiness == true or base.pending.bombard == true, -- Bombard directly inflicts clumsiness, not asthma; asthma comes from Air -- resonance procs, so only trust the actual aff state here. asthma = base.asthma == true, fulminated = base.fulminated == true, epilepsy = base.epilepsy == true, paralysis = base.paralysis == true, dissonance = base.dissonance == true, conflagrate = base.conflagrate == true, conflagration = base.conflagration == true, scalded = base.scalded == true or base.pending.magma == true, slickness = base.slickness == true, anorexia = base.anorexia == true, dizziness = base.dizziness == true, stupidity = base.stupidity == true, nausea = base.nausea == true, weariness = base.weariness == true, ablaze = base.ablaze == true, kelpscore = _kelpscore(), res = { air = tonumber(base.res.air or 0) or 0, earth = tonumber(base.res.earth or 0) or 0, fire = tonumber(base.res.fire or 0) or 0, water = tonumber(base.res.water or 0) or 0, synced = base.res.synced == true, }, pending = base.pending, raw = base.raw, hellfumes = _hellfumes_up() or base.pending.hellfumes == true, route = { target = route.target, room_id = route.room_id, phase = route.phase, subphase = route.subphase, bucket = route.bucket, postconv = route.postconv == true, opening_dehydrate_done = route.opening_dehydrate_done == true, last_reset_reason = route.last_reset_reason, }, focus_punish_armed = _focus_armed(), dissonance_stage = tonumber(dis.stage or 0) or 0, dissonance_confidence = tostring(dis.confidence or "low"), dissonance_last_evidence = tostring(dis.last_evidence or ""), }

local function _can_staffcast_horripilation(tgt) local cmd = ("staff cast horripilation %s"):format(tgt) local ok, why = _spell_guard("horripilation", tgt, cmd) return ok, why, cmd end

local function _choice(cmd, category, decision, reason, phase, subphase, bucket) return { cmd = cmd, category = category, decision = decision, reason = reason, phase = phase, subphase = subphase, bucket = bucket, } end
local function _reject(rejects, decision, reason) rejects[#rejects + 1] = { decision = tostring(decision or ""), reason = tostring(reason or ""), } end
local function _pick_bombard_revisit(st, rejects) if st.bombard_need ~= true then _reject(rejects, "bombard_revisit", "not_needed") return nil end local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_bombard(st.target) if ok then return _choice(cmd, "resonance_progress", "bombard_revisit", st.bombard_reason, "progress", "bombard", "resonance_progress") end _reject(rejects, "bombard_revisit", why ~= "" and why or st.bombard_reason) return nil end
local function _pick_fulminate_branch(st, rejects) if st.fulminate_need ~= true then _reject(rejects, "fulminate_continue", "not_needed") return nil end local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_fulminate(st.target) if ok then return _choice(cmd, "fulminate_branch", "fulminate_continue", _fulm_reason(st), "progress", "fulminate", "fulminate_branch") end _reject(rejects, "fulminate_continue", why ~= "" and why or _fulm_reason(st)) return nil end
local function _pick_fire_progress(st, rejects) if tonumber(st.res.fire or 0) >= 2 then _reject(rejects, "fire_progress", "fire_moderate_ready") return nil end
if st.scalded ~= true or tonumber(st.res.earth or 0) < 2 then local ok_magma, why_magma, cmd_magma = _can_cast_magma(st.target) if ok_magma then local why = (tonumber(st.res.earth or 0) < 2) and "fire_earth_progress" or "fire_progress_scalded" return _choice(cmd_magma, "resonance_progress", "fire_progress", why, "progress", "fire", "resonance_progress") end _reject(rejects, "fire_progress_magma", why_magma ~= "" and why_magma or "magma_blocked") end
local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_firelash(st.target) if ok then return _choice(cmd, "resonance_progress", "fire_progress", "fire_moderate_missing", "progress", "fire", "resonance_progress") end _reject(rejects, "fire_progress_firelash", why ~= "" and why or "firelash_blocked") return nil end
local function _pick_dissonance_push(st, rejects) if st.dissonance_stage >= 4 then _reject(rejects, "dissonance_push", "stage_4") return nil end local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_or_embed_dissonance_builder(st.target) if ok then return _choice(cmd, "dissonance_push", "dissonance_push", "dissonance_stage_" .. tostring(st.dissonance_stage), "gate", "dissonance", "dissonance_push") end _reject(rejects, "dissonance_push", why ~= "" and why or ("dissonance_stage_" .. tostring(st.dissonance_stage))) return nil end
local function _pick_lock_pressure(st, rejects) local phase = st.postconv and "postconv" or "lock" local function attempt(builder, decision, reason, ...) local ok, why, cmd = builder(st.target, ...) if ok then return _choice(cmd, "lock_pressure", decision, reason, phase, decision, "lock_pressure") end _reject(rejects, decision, why ~= "" and why or reason) return nil end
if not st.asthma then local choice = attempt(_can_cast_bombard, "lock_asthma", "asthma_missing") if choice then return choice end end if not st.slickness then local choice if not st.frozen then choice = attempt(_can_cast_freeze, "lock_freeze", "slickness_needs_frozen") else choice = attempt(_can_cast_mudslide, "lock_slickness", "slickness_missing") end if choice then return choice end end if not st.paralysis then local choice = attempt(_can_cast_fulminate, "lock_paralysis", _fulm_reason(st)) if choice then return choice end end if not st.anorexia then -- Water resonance enables the passive proc; the proc message confirms anorexia. local choice = attempt(_can_cast_freeze, "lock_anorexia", "anorexia_missing") if choice then return choice end end if st.mental_count < 2 then if not st.epilepsy then local choice = attempt(_can_cast_fulminate, "lock_epilepsy", "epilepsy_missing") if choice then return choice end end if not st.stupidity and MF.cfg.shock_lightning_enabled ~= false then local choice = attempt(_can_staffcast_lightning, "lock_stupidity", "stupidity_missing") if choice then return choice end end if not st.dizziness then local choice if st.res.air >= 3 then choice = attempt(_can_cast_emanation, "lock_dizziness", "dizziness_missing", "air") else choice = attempt(_can_cast_bombard, "lock_air_build", "dizziness_needs_major_air") end if choice then return choice end end end return nil end
local function _pick_resonance_fallback(st, rejects) local phase = st.postconv and "postconv" or "maintenance" for _, element in ipairs({ "earth", "fire", "water", "air" }) do if st.res[element] >= 3 then local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_emanation(st.target, element) if ok then return _choice(cmd, "maintenance", "emanation_dump", "major_" .. element, phase, element, "maintenance") end _reject(rejects, "emanation_dump", why) return nil, why end end local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_dehydrate(st.target) if ok then return _choice(cmd, "maintenance", "dehydrate_fallback", "no_major_resonance", phase, "dehydrate", "maintenance") end _reject(rejects, "dehydrate_fallback", why) return nil, why end
local function _pick_postconv_action(st, rejects) if st.postconv ~= true then _reject(rejects, "postconv_action", "postconv_false") return nil end
if st.destroy_ready == true then local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_destroy(st.target) if ok then return _choice(cmd, "postconv_finish", "destroy_now", "destroy_ready", "postconv", "destroy", "postconv_finish") end _reject(rejects, "destroy_now", why ~= "" and why or "destroy_ready") else _reject(rejects, "destroy_now", st.destroy_blocker) end
local lock = _pick_lock_pressure(st, rejects) if lock then return lock end
if st.fulminate_need == true then local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_fulminate(st.target) if ok then return _choice(cmd, "postconv_finish", "fulminate_continue", _fulm_reason(st), "postconv", "fulminate", "postconv_finish") end _reject(rejects, "postconv_fulminate", why ~= "" and why or _fulm_reason(st)) end
if st.scalded ~= true then local ok_magma, why_magma, cmd_magma = _can_cast_magma(st.target) if ok_magma then return _choice(cmd_magma, "postconv_finish", "burst_pressure", "postconv_magma_pressure", "postconv", "burst", "postconv_finish") end _reject(rejects, "postconv_magma", why_magma ~= "" and why_magma or "magma_blocked") end
local fallback, fallback_blocker = _pick_resonance_fallback(st, rejects) if fallback then return fallback end if fallback_blocker then return nil end
if st.freeze_missing == true then local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_freeze(st.target) if ok then return _choice(cmd, "maintenance", "maintenance_refresh", "freeze_package_incomplete", "postconv", "maintenance", "maintenance") end _reject(rejects, "postconv_freeze", why ~= "" and why or "freeze_package_incomplete") end
if st.bombard_need == true then local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_bombard(st.target) if ok then return _choice(cmd, "maintenance", "maintenance_refresh", st.bombard_reason, "postconv", "maintenance", "maintenance") end _reject(rejects, "postconv_bombard", why ~= "" and why or st.bombard_reason) end
return nil end
local function _select_command(tgt) local st = _snapshot(tgt) local rejects = {}
if st.target_valid ~= true then _set_route_stage(tgt, "hold", "invalid_target", "maintenance") return nil, st, rejects, "invalid_target" end
if st.hellfumes ~= true then local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_hellfumes(tgt) _set_route_stage(tgt, ok and "opener" or "hold", "hellfumes", "opener_setup") if ok then return _choice(cmd, "opener_setup", "hellfumes_open", "hellfumes_missing", "opener", "hellfumes", "opener_setup"), st, rejects, "" end _reject(rejects, "hellfumes_open", why ~= "" and why or "hellfumes_missing") return nil, st, rejects, why ~= "" and why or "hellfumes_missing" end
if st.pebble_needed == true and st.postconv ~= true then local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_pebble(tgt) _set_route_stage(tgt, ok and "opener" or "hold", "pebble", "opener_setup") if ok then return _choice(cmd, "opener_setup", "pebble_seed", "scalded_unconfirmed_earth_absent", "opener", "pebble", "opener_setup"), st, rejects, "" end _reject(rejects, "pebble_seed", why) return nil, st, rejects, why end
if st.route.opening_dehydrate_done ~= true then local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_dehydrate(tgt) _set_route_stage(tgt, ok and "opener" or "hold", "dehydrate", "opener_setup") if ok then return _choice(cmd, "opener_setup", "dehydrate_open", "opening_dehydrate", "opener", "dehydrate", "opener_setup"), st, rejects, "" end _reject(rejects, "dehydrate_open", why) return nil, st, rejects, why end
if st.waterbonds ~= true then local ok, why, cmd = _can_staffcast_horripilation(tgt) _set_route_stage(tgt, ok and "opener" or "hold", "horripilation", "opener_setup") if ok then return _choice(cmd, "opener_setup", "horripilation_open", "waterbonds_missing", "opener", "horripilation", "opener_setup"), st, rejects, "" end _reject(rejects, "horripilation_open", why ~= "" and why or "waterbonds_missing") return nil, st, rejects, why ~= "" and why or "waterbonds_missing" end
if st.freeze_missing == true and st.postconv ~= true then if st.freeze_requires_water_refresh == true then local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_freeze(tgt) _set_route_stage(tgt, ok and "opener" or "hold", "freeze", "freeze_reopen") if ok then return _choice(cmd, "freeze_reopen", "freeze_reopen", "water_moderate_missing", "opener", "freeze", "freeze_reopen"), st, rejects, "" end _reject(rejects, "freeze_reopen", why ~= "" and why or "water_moderate_missing") return nil, st, rejects, why ~= "" and why or "water_moderate_missing" end _reject(rejects, "freeze_reopen", "deferred_for_resonance_pivot") end
if st.postconv == true then local postconv = _pick_postconv_action(st, rejects) if postconv then _set_route_stage(tgt, postconv.phase, postconv.subphase, postconv.bucket) return postconv, st, rejects, "" end _set_route_stage(tgt, "hold", "postconv", "postconv_finish") return nil, st, rejects, "postconv_no_legal_action" end
local lock = _pick_lock_pressure(st, rejects) if lock then _set_route_stage(tgt, lock.phase, lock.subphase, lock.bucket) return lock, st, rejects, "" end
local bombard = _pick_bombard_revisit(st, rejects) if bombard then _set_route_stage(tgt, bombard.phase, bombard.subphase, bombard.bucket) return bombard, st, rejects, "" end
local fulm = _pick_fulminate_branch(st, rejects) if fulm then _set_route_stage(tgt, fulm.phase, fulm.subphase, fulm.bucket) return fulm, st, rejects, "" end
local fire = _pick_fire_progress(st, rejects) if fire then _set_route_stage(tgt, fire.phase, fire.subphase, fire.bucket) return fire, st, rejects, "" end
local diss = _pick_dissonance_push(st, rejects) if diss then _set_route_stage(tgt, diss.phase, diss.subphase, diss.bucket) return diss, st, rejects, "" end
if st.conv_ready == true then local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_convergence(tgt) _set_route_stage(tgt, ok and "gate" or "hold", "convergence", "convergence_now") if ok then return _choice(cmd, "convergence_now", "convergence_now", "all_gates_satisfied", "gate", "convergence", "convergence_now"), st, rejects, "" end _reject(rejects, "convergence_now", why ~= "" and why or "all_gates_satisfied") return nil, st, rejects, why ~= "" and why or "all_gates_satisfied" end _reject(rejects, "convergence_now", st.conv_blocker)
if st.freeze_missing == true then local ok, why, cmd = _can_cast_freeze(tgt) if ok then _set_route_stage(tgt, "maintenance", "freeze", "maintenance") return _choice(cmd, "maintenance", "maintenance_refresh", "freeze_package_incomplete", "maintenance", "freeze", "maintenance"), st, rejects, "" end _reject(rejects, "maintenance_freeze", why ~= "" and why or "freeze_package_incomplete") end
local fallback, why = _pick_resonance_fallback(st, rejects) if fallback then _set_route_stage(tgt, fallback.phase, fallback.subphase, fallback.bucket) return fallback, st, rejects, "" end _set_route_stage(tgt, "hold", "idle", "maintenance") return nil, st, rejects, why or "no_legal_action" end
local function _is_destroy_cmd(cmd) return _lc(cmd):match("^cast%s+destroy%s+at%s+") ~= nil end
local function _apply_execute_opts(opts, payload) local cmd = type(payload) == "table" and _trim(payload.eq) or "" if _is_destroy_cmd(cmd) then opts.queue_verb = "addclearfull" opts.clearfull_lane = "eq" end return opts end
local function _clear_eq_queue() end
local function _emit_payload(payload, category) local opts = { reason = "magi_focus:" .. tostring(category or "attack"), kind = "offense", commit = true, route = "magi_focus", target = _trim(type(payload) == "table" and payload.target or ""), } _apply_execute_opts(opts, payload)
if RI and type(RI.emit_route_payload) == "function" then return RI.emit_route_payload("magi_focus", { target = opts.target, lanes = { eq = payload and payload.eq }, meta = { route = "magi_focus", main_lane = "eq", main_category = tostring(category or ""), }, }, opts) end
if type(Yso.emit) == "function" then return Yso.emit(payload, opts) == true end
return false end
local function _payload_each_eq(payload, fn) if type(payload) ~= "table" or type(fn) ~= "function" then return end local row = payload.eq if type(row) == "string" then fn(row) return end if type(row) == "table" then for i = 1, #row do if type(row[i]) == "string" then fn(row[i]) end end end end
local function _capture_target(cmd, pat) return _trim(_lc(cmd):match(pat) or "") end
local function _attack_opts(arg) if type(arg) == "table" and (arg.preview ~= nil or arg.ctx ~= nil) then return arg.ctx, (arg.preview == true) end return arg, false end

route.phase or "", phase = route.phase or "", subphase = route.subphase or "", bucket = route.bucket or "", decision = choice and choice.decision or "", reason = choice and choice.reason or "", blocker = blocker or "", planned = { eq = choice and choice.cmd or "" }, threshold_rule = st and st.threshold_rule or "", resonance = st and { air = st.res.air, earth = st.res.earth, fire = last_sent_cmd = MF.state and MF.state.last_sent_cmd or "", pending = MF.state and MF.state.pending or {}, }) end
local function _clear_runtime_state(reason) RC.reset_runtime_state(MF.state, reason) end
function MF.init() MF.cfg = MF.cfg or {} -- Backfill settings for an already-loaded route when the alias is refreshed. if MF.cfg.shock_lightning_enabled == nil then MF.cfg.shock_lightning_enabled = true end for key, value in pairs({ pebble_pending_s = 1.00, dehydrate_pending_s = 1.00, mudslide_pending_s = 1.00, lightning_pending_s = 1.00, emanation_pending_s = 2.40 }) do if MF.cfg[key] == nil then MF.cfg[key] = value end end MF.state = MF.state or {} MF.state.template = MF.state.template or { last_reason = "init", last_disable_reason = "", last_payload = nil, last_target = "" } RC.ensure_pending(MF.state, PENDING_SLOTS) if RI and type(RI.ensure_waiting_state) == "function" then RI.ensure_waiting_state(MF.state, "magi_focus") end _route_slot() MF.state.loop_delay = tonumber(MF.state.loop_delay or MF.cfg.loop_delay or 0.15) or 0.15 MF.state.busy = (MF.state.busy == true) _set_loop_enabled((MF.state.loop_enabled == true) or (MF.state.enabled == true)) return true end
function MF.reset(reason) MF.init() _clear_pending_all() _reset_route(reason or "manual") _clear_runtime_state(reason or "manual") if RI and type(RI.clear_waiting) == "function" then RI.clear_waiting(MF.state, "magi_focus") end Dissonance.reset() return true end
function MF.is_enabled() return MF.state and MF.state.enabled == true end
function MF.is_active() return _route_is_active() end
function MF.can_run(ctx) MF.init() if not MF.is_enabled() then return false, "disabled" end if not MF.is_active() then return false, "inactive" end if type(Yso.offense_paused) == "function" and Yso.offense_paused() then return false, "paused" end
local tgt = _trim((ctx and ctx.target) or _target()) if tgt == "" then _reset_route("no_target") return false, "no_target" end if not _is_magi() then return false, "wrong_class" end if not _tgt_valid(tgt) then _reset_route("invalid_target") return false, "invalid_target" end _ensure_context(tgt) return true, tgt end
function MF.attack_function(arg) local ctx, preview = _attack_opts(arg) MF.init() if type(RC.entourage_sync) == "function" then RC.entourage_sync(MF, (ctx and ctx.target) or _target(), _is_magi(), preview) end local ok, info = MF.can_run(ctx) if not ok then if preview then return nil, info end return false, info end
local tgt = info if MF.state.last_target ~= "" and not _same_target(MF.state.last_target, tgt) then _clear_pending_all() _reset_route("target_swap") _clear_runtime_state("target_swap") Dissonance.reset() end MF.state.last_target = tgt
local choice, st, rejects, blocker = _select_command(tgt) MF.state.template.last_reason = blocker MF.state.template.last_target = tgt _update_explain(tgt, st, choice, rejects, blocker)
if not choice or _trim(choice.cmd) == "" then MF.state.template.last_payload = nil if preview then return nil, blocker end return false, blocker end
local payload = { route = "magi_focus", target = tgt, lanes = { eq = choice.cmd }, meta = { main_lane = "eq", main_category = choice.category, main_reason = choice.reason, decision = choice.decision, state = st, rejects = rejects, explain = MF.state.explain, }, }
MF.state.template.last_payload = payload
if preview then return payload end
