Script.name: Dragon support
Script.script: -- Shared Yso targeting only. Readiness is local to Dragon, never truthy strings. Yso = Yso or {}; Yso.dragon = Yso.dragon or {} local D=Yso.dragon D.state=D.state or {breath=false,purge=false,curse=false} function D.active() local g=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Skills and gmcp.Char.Skills.Groups or {} for k,v in pairs(g) do local name=type(v)=='table' and v.name or v if tostring(name):lower()=='dragoncraft' or tostring(k):lower()=='dragoncraft' then return true end end return false end function D.target() local t=type(Yso.get_target)=='function' and Yso.get_target() or '' local valid=Yso.target_is_valid or Yso.is_current_target if type(t)~='string' or t=='' or (type(valid)=='function' and not valid(t)) then return nil end return t end function D.emit(command,lane,kind) if not D.active() then return false end local payload=type(command)=='table' and command or {[lane or 'eq']=command} for _,key in ipairs({'eq','bal'}) do if payload[key] and payload[key]~='' then local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local value=v[key] if key=='bal' and value==nil then value=v.balance end if key=='eq' and value==nil then value=v.equilibrium end -- Explicit GMCP balance loss overrides even a stale shared ready helper. if key=='bal' and (value==false or tostring(value)=='0') then return false end local ready=Yso.locks and Yso.locks[key..'_ready'] or Yso.state and Yso.state[key..'_ready'] if type(ready)=='function' then local ok,result=pcall(ready) if not ok or result~=true then return false end else if value~=true and tostring(value)~='1' then return false end end end end return Yso.emit(payload,{kind=kind or 'offense',reason='dragon:manual',commit=true,allow_eqbal=true}) end function D.manual(skill,arg) if not D.active() then return false end local t=D.target() if skill=='glide' then local a,b=tostring(arg or ''):match('^(%w+) (%w+)$') return a and D.emit('glide '..a..' '..b,'bal','utility') or false elseif skill=='leap' then local aff=Legacy and Legacy.Curing and Legacy.Curing.Affs or {} if aff.paralysis or aff.prone or not tostring(arg or ''):match('^%w+$') then return false end return D.emit('leap '..arg,'bal','utility') elseif skill=='breathstorm' then return D.state.breath and D.emit('breathstorm') or false elseif skill=='tailsweep' then return D.emit('tailsweep','bal') end if not t then return false end if skill=='blast' then return D.state.breath and D.emit('blast '..t) or false elseif skill=='breathstream' then if not D.state.breath or not tostring(arg or ''):match('^%w+$') then return false end return D.emit('breathstream '..t..' '..arg) elseif skill=='roar' then return D.emit('dragonroar '..t) elseif skill=='rend_left' then return D.emit('rend '..t..' left arm curare','bal') elseif skill=='attack' then local a=dragon_att:new(); a:curse('sensitivity',1); a:act('rend'); return a:commit() elseif skill=='key' then if ak and ak.defs and ak.defs.shield then if D.state.breath then return D.emit('blast '..t) end return D.emit('tailsmash '..t,'bal') end if affstrack and affstrack.score and (tonumber(affstrack.score.prone) or 0)>=100 then return D.emit('bite '..t,'bal') end end return false end return D

Script.name: Dragon functions
Script.script:
local unpack = unpack or table.unpack
dragon_att = {} dragon_att.__index = dragon_att dragon_att.settings = {} --bal_move --eq_move --eq_special --no_bal = {} dragon_att.settings.stand = false dragon_att.settings.lightpipes = false dragon_att.settings.pipes = {} -- target dragon_att.settings.target_limb = "nothing" -- dir -- bal_list = {} -- bal_str dragon_att.settings.sep = Yso.sep or "&&" --dragon_att.settings.my_spear = my_spear or "spear" --sent_att.settings.my_axe = my_axe or "handaxe" dragon_att.refs = {}
dragon_att.refs.bal_moves = { gut = true, rend = true, trample = true, tailsweep = true, becalm = true, demolition = true, tailsmash = true, fly = true, block = true, tumble = true, }
dragon_att.refs.eq_moves = { heal = true, enmesh = true, blast = true, curse_rand = true, breathstorm = true, strip = true, roar = true, incantation = true, }
dragon_att.refs.bal_moves_sp = { dragonflex = true, }
dragon_att.refs.eq_moves_sp = { dragonsense = true, gust = true, illusion = true, veilglance = true, veildeliver = true, contemplate = true, }
dragon_att.refs.validcurses = { paralysis = true, impatience = true, weariness = true, asthma = true, stupidity = true, recklessness = true, sensitivity = true, }
function dragon_att:new() local new_att = {} setmetatable(new_att,self) new_att.settings = {} setmetatable(new_att.settings, {__index = self.settings}) new_att.settings.no_bal = {} return new_att end
function dragon_att:gut(venom) if venom then self.bal_str = string.format("gut %s %s", Yso.dragon.target(), venom) else self.bal_str = string.format("gut %s", Yso.dragon.target()) end return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:rend(venom, limb) local venom = venom or "curare" if not limb then self.bal_str = string.format("rend %s %s", Yso.dragon.target(), venom) else self.bal_str = string.format("rend %s %s %s", Yso.dragon.target(), limb, venom) end return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:trample() self.bal_str = "trample" return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:becalm(target) if not target then self.bal_str = "becalm" else self.bal_str = string.format("becalm %s", target) end return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:demolition(dir) self.bal_str = string.format("demolish wall %s", dir) return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:tailsweep() self.bal_str = "tailsweep" return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:tailsmash() self.bal_str = string.format("tailsmash %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:heal() self.eq_str = "dragonheal" return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:enmesh() self.eq_str = string.format("enmesh %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:blast() self.eq_str = string.format("blast %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:curse(what, wait) if self.refs.validcurses[what] and tonumber(wait) then self.settings.curse = {what=what, wait=tonumber(wait)} end end
function dragon_att:curse_rand() self.eq_str = string.format("dragoncurse %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:breathstorm() self.eq_str = "breathstorm" return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:strip() self.eq_str = string.format("breathstrip %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:roar() self.eq_str = string.format("dragonroar %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:incantation() self.eq_str = string.format("incantation %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:dragonflex() self.bal_str = "dragonflex" return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:dragonsense() self.eq_str = string.format("dragonsense %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:gust() self.eq_str = string.format("breathgust %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:illusion(line, lethal, target) local conjure if not target then conjure = "conjure illusion" else conjure = string.format("conjure %s illusion", target) end
if lethal then conjure = conjure.." lethal" end
self.eq_str = string.format("%s %s", conjure, line) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:veilglance() self.eq_str = string.format("veilglance %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:veildeliver(stuff, target) self.eq_str = string.format("veildeliver %s to %s", stuff, target) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:contemplate() self.eq_str = string.format("contemplate %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:parry(limb) if type(limb) ~= "string" then error("dragon_att:parry needs a limb specified") return end self.to_parry = limb end
function dragon_att:act(move, args) if self.refs.bal_moves[move] then self.bal_move = move self.bal_args = args self.eq_move = false elseif self.refs.eq_moves[move] then self.bal_move = false self.eq_move = move self.eq_args = args self.eq_special = false elseif self.refs.eq_moves_sp[move] then self.eq_move = false self.eq_special = move self.eq_special_args = args elseif self.refs.bal_moves_sp[move] then self.bal_move = false self.bal_special = move self.bal_special_args = args end end
function dragon_att:no_bal(move) table.insert(self.settings.no_bal, move) end
function dragon_att:stand(negate, args) if not negate then self.settings.stand = true else self.settings.stand = false end end
function dragon_att:setpipes(pipelist) if type(pipelist) ~= "table" or #pipelist == 0 then error("pipe list needs to be an array of pipe ids") return end self.settings.pipes = pipelist return self.settings.pipes end
function dragon_att:lightpipes(negate) if not negate then self.settings.lightpipes = true else self.settings.lightpipes = false end end
function dragon_att:summon(btype) if type(btype) ~= "string" then error("breath type needs to be a string") return end
self.settings.summon = btype end
function dragon_att:commit() if not Yso.dragon.active() or not Yso.dragon.target() then return false end local do_first = {}
if self.settings.stand then table.insert(do_first, "stand") end
if self.settings.summon then table.insert(do_first, string.format("summon %s", self.settings.summon)) end if self.settings.lightpipes and #self.settings.pipes > 0 then for _,v in ipairs(self.settings.pipes) do table.insert(do_first, string.format("light %s", v)) end end if self.to_parry then table.insert(do_first, string.format("clawparry %s", self.to_parry)) end local actions = {} local actions_free = {} local balance_actions, eq_actions = {}, {} if #do_first > 0 then table.insert(actions_free, table.concat(do_first,self.settings.sep)) end if #self.settings.no_bal > 0 then table.insert(actions_free, table.concat(self.settings.no_bal, self.settings.sep)) end if self.settings.curse then table.insert(actions_free, string.format("dragoncurse %s %s %d", Yso.dragon.target(), self.settings.curse.what, self.settings.curse.wait)) end
-- cecho("<red:green>stopped") if self.bal_move then if self.bal_args then table.insert(balance_actions, self[self.bal_move](self, unpack(self.bal_args))) else -- print(self[self.bal_move](self)) table.insert(balance_actions, self[self.bal_move](self)) end end
if self.eq_move then if self.eq_args then table.insert(eq_actions, self[self.eq_move](self, unpack(self.eq_args))) else table.insert(eq_actions, self[self.eq_move](self)) end end if self.eq_special then if self.eq_special_args then table.insert(eq_actions, self[self.eq_special](self,unpack(self.eq_special_args))) else table.insert(eq_actions, self[self.eq_special](self)) end end if self.bal_special then if self.bal_special_args then table.insert(balance_actions, self[self.bal_special](self, unpack(self.bal_special_args))) else table.insert(balance_actions, self[self.bal_special](self)) end end local payload = {} for key, list in pairs({free=actions_free, eq=eq_actions, bal=balance_actions}) do if #list>0 then payload[key]=table.concat(list,Yso.sep or "&&") end end for _,key in ipairs({"free","eq","bal"}) do if payload[key] then table.insert(actions,payload[key]) end end local attack_str = table.concat(actions, Yso.sep or "&&") if attack_str == "" then return end if not Yso.dragon.emit(payload) then return false end --display(actions) return table.concat(actions, self.settings.sep) end

Script.name: Rend venoms
Airlord skillchart
Script.script: -- In-game AB Duress screenshots supplied 2026-10-11/12. Unknown timings stay nil. -- Reference data only: afflictions lists contain direct applications, not prerequisites. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.ref = Yso.ref or {} local R = {meta={class='Airlord',skillset='Duress',updated='2026-10-12',source='User supplied AB screenshots'},skills={}} Yso.ref.airlord = R local function skill(name,syntax,targets,afflictions,details) local row=details or {} row.syntax=syntax; row.targets=targets; row.afflictions=afflictions or {} R.skills[name]=row end skill('buffet','MANIFEST BUFFET <target>','adventurers and denizens',{}, { damage=true,damage_scales_with={'pressure','disloyalty','tension','manaleech','deadening'}, notes='Successive uses against the same target relapse for additional damage after two seconds.',relapse_s=2}) skill('gale','MANIFEST GALE <target>','adventurers and denizens',{}, { removes={'shield'},conditional_afflictions={{affliction='manaleech',when='Successful shield removal against an adventurer'}}}) skill('tempest','MANIFEST TEMPEST','self',{}, {defense='Damage mitigation'}) skill('tornado','MANIFEST TORNADO','adventurers and room',{}, { notes='Hinders departure by flying characters, including allies; fellow Air Elemental Lords are exempt.'}) skill('whisper','AERO WHISPER <target>','adventurers',{}, { effect='Locate an individual and report their area and room if they can be found'}) skill('glide','GLIDE <direction> [distance]','self',{}, { requires_flying=true,min_distance=1,max_distance=11,wilderness_max_distance=5, movement='Travel multiple rooms on air currents in a given direction; distance is optional'}) skill('scour','AERO SCOUR <target>','adventurers and denizens',{'disloyalty'}, { damage=true,adventurer_afflictions=true, relapse={absent='Reapply disloyalty and end periodic ticks',present='Stun and brief balance loss; ticks continue',pressure_accelerated=true}, denizen={damage_type='cutting',relapse_s=2}}) skill('drift','AERO DRIFT','self',{}, {movement='Ascend into the sky'}) skill('zephyr','MANIFEST ZEPHYR <target>','adventurers and denizens',{'manaleech'}, { damage=true,adventurer_afflictions=true, conditional_afflictions={{affliction='deadening',when='Relapse while manaleech remains and deadening is absent'}}, relapse={absent='Reapply manaleech and end periodic ticks',present='Apply deadening; short mental blackout if both afflictions remain',pressure_accelerated=true}, denizen={damage_type='cold',relapse_s=2}}) skill('gust','GUST <direction>','self',{}, {movement='Pass walls and similar barriers',notes='Both origin and destination must be outdoors.'}) skill('soar','AERO SOAR <LOW|HIGH|STRATOSPHERE>','self',{}, {movement='Travel to cloud locations at the chosen elevation'}) skill('asphyxiate','AERO ASPHYXIATE <target>','adventurers',{}, {effect='Reveal the type of smoke inhaled by the target'}) skill('strangle','AERO STRANGLE <target>','adventurers and denizens',{'deadening'}, { damage=true,adventurer_afflictions=true, conditional_afflictions={{affliction='disrupted',when='Relapse while deadening remains; AK tracking key'}}, relapse={absent='Reapply deadening and end periodic ticks',present='Disrupt the target; ticks continue',pressure_accelerated=true}, denizen={damage_type='asphyxiation',relapse_s=2}}) skill('lightning','MANIFEST LIGHTNING <target>','adventurers',{}, { movement='Reach a flying target above you, or travel to an outdoor target on the same continent while flying', notes='Ground-to-sky use costs no balance. Long-distance use lands you at the destination and costs a short balance. Both have a short reuse delay.'}) skill('updraft','MANIFEST UPDRAFT <target>','adventurers',{}, { damage=true,checks_afflictions={'tension'}, notes='Outdoor ground target: launch into sky. Indoor ground target: ceiling impact and damage. Flying target: force upward and damage. Recovery twice as fast with tension. Death bypasses starburst and leaves no corpse.'}) skill('tropostheria',nil,'adventurers',{}, {passive=true, effect='Attack flying targets from the ground; holding breath no longer defends against your air mastery'}) skill('silence','AERO SILENCE <target>','adventurers',{}, {effect='Prevents conventional hearing and communication'}) skill('tailwind','MANIFEST TAILWIND <target>','adventurers',{}, {duration_s=30, effect='Pursue the first successful movement by the target; consumed on pursuit'}) skill('effervescence','MANIFEST EFFERVESCENCE','adventurers and room',{}, { effect='Lingering vapour periodically robs foes of breath; holding breath is only a partial defense'}) skill('pressure','AERO PRESSURE <target>','adventurers',{}, { state_effects={'pressure'},boost_afflictions={'manaleech','disloyalty','deadening'},max_boost_afflictions=2, notes='Builds pressure, with increased gain from up to two listed afflictions. Delays movement; at least two elevations prevent many leaping abilities. Exact gain formula not specified in supplied AB.'}) skill('gauge','GAUGE <target>','adventurers',{}, {balance_cost=0,equilibrium_cost=0,reuse_approx_s=1, effect='Report current pressure elevation'}) skill('tension','AERO TENSION <target>','adventurers',{'tension'}, { state_effects={'pressure'},pressure_gain=1,effect='Prevents landing while flying; external sources can still ground the target'}) skill('skyhammer','MANIFEST SKYHAMMER','adventurers and room',{}, {damage='extreme',room_cooldown_s=60, notes='Windup blocks other actions; damages flying characters and casts them to the ground.'}) skill('compression','AERO COMPRESSION <target>','adventurers',{}, {execute=true,requires_pressure=6}) skill('stormfront','MANIFEST STORMFRONT','adventurers and room',{}, {duration_s=60,cooldown_s=300, effect='Prevents non-adjacent long-distance travel into the room'}) skill('mistral','MANIFEST MISTRAL; RUSH <direction>','self',{}, { effect='Temporary immune wind form with restricted actions', notes='Transformation has a short windup unless already flying. Channeled RUSH bypasses closed but not locked doors. Exact duration unspecified.'}) -- Balance consumption verified in the supplied spar and follow-up screenshots. for _,name in ipairs({'asphyxiate','strangle','zephyr','scour','pressure','compression','tension','updraft'}) do R.skills[name].lane='bal' end R.skills.gauge.lane='free' return R

Script.name: Compression logic
Script.script: -- Gauge observations belong to Yso's current target; no separate target selector. Yso = Yso or {}; Yso.off = Yso.off or {}; Yso.off.airlord = Yso.off.airlord or {} local C = {}; Yso.off.airlord.compression = C C.state = {} C.fresh_s = 3 local function now() return Yso.util.now() end local function current(who) local t=type(Yso.get_target)=='function' and Yso.get_target() or '' return type(who)=='string' and type(t)=='string' and t~='' and who:lower()==t:lower() end function C.clear() C.state={} end function C.observe(who,level) level=tonumber(level) if not current(who) or not level or level<0 then return false end C.state={who=who,level=level,at=now()} for _,route in pairs({Yso.off.airlord.lock,Yso.off.airlord.damage}) do if level<6 then route.release_execute() end if route.sync_updraft then route.sync_updraft() end if route.sync_buffet then route.sync_buffet() end end C.wake(); return true end local gauge_levels={ ['at normal levels']=0, ['slightly elevated']=1, ['elevated']=2, ['moderately elevated']=3, ['severely elevated']=4, ['extremely elevated']=5, ['terminally elevated']=6, } function C.observe_description(who,description) local level=gauge_levels[description] if level==nil then return false end return C.observe(who,level) end function C.invalidate(who) if not current(who) then return false end C.clear() for _,route in pairs({Yso.off.airlord.lock,Yso.off.airlord.damage}) do route.release_execute() if route.sync_updraft then route.sync_updraft() end if route.sync_buffet then route.sync_buffet() end end C.wake(); return true end function C.level() local s=C.state if current(s.who) and now()-s.at<=C.fresh_s then return s.level end end function C.ready() return (C.level() or 0)>=6 end function C.wake() if Yso.mode and type(Yso.mode.nudge_route_loop)=='function' then Yso.mode.nudge_route_loop('airlord_lock','pressure_observation') Yso.mode.nudge_route_loop('airlord_damage','pressure_observation') end end return C

Script.name: Airlord route runtime
Script.script:
-- Shared Airlord delivery and lifecycle. Route modules supply only their decisions. Yso = Yso or {}; Yso.off = Yso.off or {}; Yso.off.airlord = Yso.off.airlord or {} local A=Yso.off.airlord A.relapse_attacks = { {skill = 'strangle', affliction = 'deadening', command = 'aero strangle'}, {skill = 'zephyr', affliction = 'manaleech', command = 'manifest zephyr'}, {skill = 'scour', affliction = 'disloyalty', command = 'aero scour'}, }
function A.relapse_pending(skill, target) local duress = ak and ak.duress or {} if type(duress.relapse_pending) == 'function' then return duress.relapse_pending(skill, target) == true end return duress[skill .. 'relapse'] == true end
function A.make_route(slot,key,name) local M = A[slot] or {}; A[slot]=M -- Native module reload retains Lua tables: retire old owned work and strategy. if type(M.reset)=='function' then M.reset() end if M.room_handler and type(killAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then killAnonymousEventHandler(M.room_handler) end M.room_handler=nil for _,hook in ipairs({'select_command','observations','on_command','outdoor_room', 'release_updraft','sync_updraft','toggle_updraft','note_updraft','note_landed', 'buffet_ready','sync_buffet'}) do M[hook]=nil end M.key=key; M.name=name; M.alias_owned=true M.cfg=M.cfg or {loop_delay=0.15,pending_s=2.5,gauge_s=1.05} M.state=M.state or {enabled=false,loop_enabled=false} M.compression=Yso.off.airlord.compression local function now() return Yso.util.now() end local function confirmation_now() local P=Yso.Combat and Yso.Combat.Pause return P and P.confirmation_now(M.key) or now() end local function target() return type(Yso.get_target)=='function' and Yso.get_target() or '' end local function lane_ready(lane) local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local value=v[lane] if lane=='eq' and value==nil then value=v.equilibrium end if lane=='bal' and value==nil then value=v.balance end -- Package balance helpers may be optimistic when no state helper is loaded. -- A confirmed GMCP spend must still block a balance attack. if value==false or tostring(value)=='0' then return false end local locks=Yso.locks if locks and type(locks[lane..'_ready'])=='function' then return locks[lane..'_ready']()==true end local state=Yso.state if state and type(state[lane..'_ready'])=='function' then return state[lane..'_ready']()==true end return value==true or tostring(value)=='1' end local function echo(text) if Yso.util and Yso.util.echo then Yso.util.echo(text) elseif type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<cyan>[Yso] '..text..'<reset>\n') end end function M.init() return true end function M.is_airlord() local info=Yso.classinfo local cls if info and type(info.get)=='function' then local ok,value=pcall(info.get) if ok and type(value)=='string' and value~='' then cls=value end end local status=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status or {} cls=cls or status.class or status.classname or Yso.class or '' cls=tostring(cls):lower():gsub('^%s+',''):gsub('%s+$','') return cls=='air elemental lord' or cls=='air elemental lady' or cls=='air elemental fae' end function M.is_active() return Yso.mode and Yso.mode.route_loop_active and Yso.mode.route_loop_active(M.key) or M.state.loop_enabled==true end local function lane_owner(lane) local q = Yso.queue return q and type(q.get_owned) == 'function' and q.get_owned(lane) or nil end
local function forget_consumed_owner(lane, owner) local q = Yso.queue if q and type(q.clear_owned) == 'function' and type(owner) == 'table' and owner.route == M.key and lane_owner(lane) == owner then q.clear_owned(lane) end end
local function clear_staged(cmd) local q=Yso.queue if not q or not cmd or type(q.list)~='function' or type(q.clear)~='function' or q.list('bal')~=cmd then return end if type(q.get_staged_owner)=='function' then local owner=q.get_staged_owner('bal') if owner and owner.route==M.key and owner.cmd==cmd then q.clear('bal') end else local hint=q._commit_hint if not hint or hint.route==M.key then q.clear('bal') end end end M.clear_staged=clear_staged function M.reset() local q=Yso.queue if q then local pending=M.state.pending clear_staged(M.state.staged_bal or (pending and pending.cmd)) forget_consumed_owner('free', M.state.observation_owned) local hint=q._commit_hint if (not hint or hint.route==M.key) and type(q.list)=='function' and type(q.clear)=='function' then if q._staged and type(q._staged.free)=='table' then local keep={} for _,cmd in ipairs(q._staged.free) do local observed=tostring(M.state.observation_target or '') local observations=M.observations and M.observations(observed) or {'gauge '..observed} if type(observations)=='string' then observations={observations} end local remove=false for _,observation in ipairs(observations) do if cmd==observation then remove=true end end if not remove then keep[#keep+1]=cmd end end q._staged.free=keep end end local owned=type(q.get_owned)=='function' and q.get_owned('bal') or nil if type(owned)=='table' and owned.route==M.key and type(q.clear_lane)=='function' then q.clear_lane('bal') end end M.state.pending=nil; M.state.gauge_at=nil; M.state.observation_target=nil M.state.observation_owned=nil M.state.staged_bal=nil M.state.execute_inflight=nil M.state.last_cmd=nil M.state.last_setup_cmd=nil M.state.hold_reason=nil M.state.updraft_context=nil; M.state.updraft_launched=nil M.compression.clear() end function M.on_target_swap() M.reset(); return true end M.on_target_change=M.on_target_swap M.on_target_slain=M.on_target_swap M.on_target_cleared=M.on_target_swap M.on_reset=M.on_target_swap M.on_pause=M.on_target_swap M.reset_route_state=M.reset function M.can_run() if not M.state.enabled or not M.state.loop_enabled then return false,'disabled' end if Yso.offense_paused and Yso.offense_paused() then return false,'paused' end if not M.is_airlord() then return false,'wrong_class' end local t=target() if type(t)~='string' or t=='' then return false,'no_target' end local valid=Yso.target_is_valid or Yso.is_current_target if type(valid)=='function' and not valid(t) then return false,'invalid_target' end return true,t end function M.attack_function() local pause=Yso.Combat and Yso.Combat.Pause if pause then local blocked,reason=pause.blocked(M.key);if blocked then return false,reason end end local ok,t=M.can_run() if not ok then if t=='paused' or t=='wrong_class' or t=='no_target' or t=='invalid_target' then if M.state.hold_reason~=t then M.reset() echo(M.name..' holding ('..t..').') end M.state.hold_reason=t end return false,t end M.state.hold_reason=nil if M.state.observation_target and M.state.observation_target~=t then M.reset() end M.state.observation_target=t if M.sync_updraft then M.sync_updraft() end if M.sync_buffet then M.sync_buffet() end -- Free observations share a cadence and do not wait for BAL/EQ. if not M.state.gauge_at or now()-M.state.gauge_at>=M.cfg.gauge_s then local observations=M.observations and M.observations(t) or 'gauge '..t -- The same Gauge/Assess payload can be submitted at the next cadence. forget_consumed_owner('free', M.state.observation_owned) if Yso.emit({free=observations,target=t,route=M.key},{kind='offense',reason='airlord:gauge',target=t,route=M.key,commit=true,wake_lane='free',free_immediate=true}) then M.state.gauge_at=now() M.state.observation_owned=lane_owner('free') end end if not lane_ready('bal') then local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local actual=v.bal if actual==nil then actual=v.balance end local pending = M.state.pending if pending and (actual==nil or actual==false or tostring(actual)=='0') then pending.saw_down=true if actual~=nil and not pending.owned then local owner = lane_owner('bal') if owner and owner.route==M.key and owner.cmd==pending.cmd then pending.owned=owner end end end if M.state.execute_inflight and (actual==false or tostring(actual)=='0') then M.state.execute_inflight.saw_down=true end return false,'bal_down' end local flight=M.state.execute_inflight if flight then if ak and ak.defs and ak.defs.shield then M.release_execute() -- Shield feedback blocks the execute; break it next. elseif flight.saw_down then if not flight.regained_at then flight.regained_at=now() end local observation=M.compression.state if M.compression.ready() and observation.at>flight.regained_at then M.release_execute() -- BAL completed and a new Gauge still shows eligibility. else return false,'execute_waiting_gauge' end elseif confirmation_now()-flight.confirmation_at>=M.cfg.pending_s then -- emit() also accepts staged commands. Neither staging nor dispatch -- proves execution; an unacknowledged submission has a bounded lifetime. if M.compression.ready() and M.compression.state.at>flight.at then M.release_execute() else return false,'execute_waiting_gauge' end else return false,'execute_inflight' end end local cmd,category=M.select_command(t) local p=M.state.pending if p and p.saw_down then -- The queue consumed this attack over the observed BAL cycle. forget_consumed_owner('bal', p.owned) M.state.pending=nil; p=nil end if p and confirmation_now()<p.until_at then -- A new confirmed execute or shield may supersede a setup attack once. if p.category==category or (category~='execute' and category~='defense_break') then return false,'pending' end end local payload={bal=cmd,target=t,route=M.key,category=category} local opts={kind='offense',reason='airlord:'..category,target=t,route=M.key,commit=true,wake_lane='bal',repeat_command=true} if not Yso.emit(payload,opts) then return false,'emit_failed' end local q=Yso.queue M.state.staged_bal=q and type(q.list)=='function' and q.list('bal')==cmd and cmd or nil M.state.pending={cmd=cmd,category=category,until_at=confirmation_now()+M.cfg.pending_s} if category=='execute' then M.state.execute_inflight={at=now(),confirmation_at=confirmation_now(),cmd=cmd,status='submitted'} end M.state.last_cmd=cmd if M.on_command then M.on_command(cmd,category) end return true,cmd end function M.release_execute() local flight=M.state.execute_inflight if flight then local q=Yso.queue if q then clear_staged(flight.cmd) local owned=type(q.get_owned)=='function' and q.get_owned('bal') or nil if type(owned)=='table' and owned.route==M.key and owned.cmd==flight.cmd and type(q.clear_lane)=='function' then q.clear_lane('bal') end end M.state.pending=nil; M.state.staged_bal=nil end M.state.execute_inflight=nil end function M.note_execute(who) if type(who)~='string' or who:lower()~=target():lower() then return false end local flight=M.state.execute_inflight if flight then flight.status='executed'; flight.saw_down=true M.note_success(who) end return true end function M.reject_pending() if not M.is_active() or not M.state.pending then return false end M.release_execute(); M.state.pending=nil return true end function M.on_send_result(payload) if type(payload)=='table' and payload.route==M.key and payload.success==false then M.release_execute(); M.state.pending=nil end end function M.note_success(who) if who and who:lower()~=target():lower() then return false end if M.state.pending then M.state.pending.acknowledged=true end return true end function M.alias_loop_on_started() M.reset(); echo(M.name..' ON.') end function M.alias_loop_on_stopped(ctx) M.reset() if not ctx or not ctx.silent then echo(M.name..' OFF ('..tostring(ctx and ctx.reason or 'manual')..').') end end function M.alias_loop_clear_waiting() M.reset(); return true end function M.alias_loop_waiting_blocks() return false end -- Match the route-loop hold behavior: transient context blocks attacks, not the toggle. M.alias_loop_stop_details={disabled=true} function M.alias_loop_on_error(err) echo('Airlord error: '..tostring(err)) end function M.on_exit() if Yso.mode and Yso.mode.stop_route_loop then Yso.mode.stop_route_loop(M.key,'exit',true) end M.reset(); return true end if Yso.off.core and Yso.off.core.register then Yso.off.core.register(M.key,M) end return M end -- Existing triggers acknowledge only the active route. function A.feedback(method,...) for _,route in pairs({A.lock,A.damage}) do if route.is_active() and type(route[method])=='function' then route[method](...) end end end return A

Script.name: Airlord lock route
Script.script:
-- Shared Airlord runtime owns scheduling, sends and cleanup. local A = Yso.off.airlord local M = A.make_route('lock', 'airlord_lock', 'Airlord lock')
function M.select_command(target) local scores = affstrack and affstrack.score or {} local duress = ak and ak.duress or {} local function confirmed(affliction) return (tonumber(scores[affliction]) or 0) >= 100 end
if ak and ak.defs and ak.defs.shield then return 'manifest gale ' .. target, 'defense_break' end
local pressure = M.compression.level() if pressure and pressure >= 6 then return 'aero compression ' .. target, 'execute' end
local boosters = 0 for _, attack in ipairs(A.relapse_attacks) do if confirmed(attack.affliction) then boosters = boosters + 1 end end local pressure_command = 'aero pressure ' .. target if boosters >= 2 or (boosters == 1 and pressure and pressure > 0) or pressure == 5 then return pressure_command, 'pressure' end
local setup_command, category for _, attack in ipairs(A.relapse_attacks) do if not confirmed(attack.affliction) and not A.relapse_pending(attack.skill, target) then setup_command, category = attack.command .. ' ' .. target, 'affliction' break end end
local tension = 'aero tension ' .. target if not setup_command and not confirmed('tension') and M.state.last_cmd ~= tension then setup_command, category = tension, 'tension' end
if setup_command then if duress.asphyxiate ~= true then return 'aero asphyxiate ' .. target, 'smoke_tracking' end return setup_command, category end
return pressure_command, 'pressure' end
return M

Script.name: Airlord damage route
Script.script:
-- Independent damage strategy; shared runtime owns delivery and cleanup. local A=Yso.off.airlord local M=A.make_route('damage','airlord_damage','Damage route') local clear_staged=M.clear_staged local function target() return type(Yso.get_target)=='function' and Yso.get_target() or '' end local function score(aff) local s=affstrack and affstrack.score return tonumber(s and s[aff]) or 0 end local function echo(text) if Yso.util and Yso.util.echo then Yso.util.echo(text) elseif type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<cyan>[Yso] '..text..'<reset>\n') end end function M.observations(t) return {'gauge '..t,'assess '..t} end function M.on_command(cmd,category) if category~='buffet' then M.state.last_setup_cmd=cmd end end -- Room.Info uses an indoors flag; outdoor rooms can have an empty details array. -- Require a complete room packet so missing GMCP never implies outdoors. function M.outdoor_room() local r=gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if type(r)~='table' or not tonumber(r.num) or type(r.name)~='string' or r.name=='' or type(r.details)~='table' then return nil end if r.name:lower():find('(indoors)',1,true) then return nil end for _,flag in pairs(r.details) do if tostring(flag):lower()=='indoors' then return nil end end return tostring(r.num) end function M.release_updraft() local p=M.state.pending if not p or p.category~='updraft' then return end clear_staged(p.cmd) local q=Yso.queue local owned=q and type(q.get_owned)=='function' and q.get_owned('bal') or nil if owned and owned.route==M.key and owned.cmd==p.cmd and type(q.clear_lane)=='function' then q.clear_lane('bal') end M.state.pending=nil; M.state.staged_bal=nil end function M.sync_updraft() local room=M.outdoor_room() local context=room and target():lower()..':'..room or nil if M.state.updraft_context~=context then M.release_updraft() M.state.updraft_context=context; M.state.updraft_launched=nil end local pressure=M.compression.level() or 0 if not M.cfg.updraft_enabled or not room or pressure<4 or pressure>=6 or (ak and ak.defs and ak.defs.shield) then M.release_updraft() end return context end function M.toggle_updraft() M.cfg.updraft_enabled=not M.cfg.updraft_enabled M.sync_updraft() echo('Airlord optional Updraft '..(M.cfg.updraft_enabled and 'ON.' or 'OFF.')) return M.cfg.updraft_enabled end function M.note_updraft(who) if type(who)~='string' or who:lower()~=target():lower() then return false end local context=M.sync_updraft() if not context then return false end M.state.updraft_launched=context M.note_success(who) return true end function M.note_landed(who) if type(who)~='string' or who:lower()~=target():lower() then return false end M.state.updraft_launched=nil return true end function M.select_command(t) local context = M.sync_updraft() local duress = ak and ak.duress or {} local pressure = M.compression.level() or 0 if ak and ak.defs and ak.defs.shield then return 'manifest gale '..t,'defense_break' end if pressure >= 6 then return 'aero compression '..t,'execute' end if M.buffet_ready() then return 'manifest buffet '..t,'buffet' end
if M.cfg.updraft_enabled and context and M.state.updraft_launched ~= context and pressure >= 4 then return 'manifest updraft '..t,'updraft' end
local boosters = 0 for _, attack in ipairs(A.relapse_attacks) do if score(attack.affliction) >= 100 then boosters = boosters + 1 end end local pressure_command = 'aero pressure '..t if boosters >= 2 then return pressure_command,'pressure' end
local tension = 'aero tension '..t local setup_command, category if score('tension') < 100 and M.state.last_setup_cmd ~= tension then setup_command, category = tension, 'tension' elseif boosters == 1 and pressure > 0 then return pressure_command,'pressure' else for _, attack in ipairs(A.relapse_attacks) do if score(attack.affliction) < 100 and not A.relapse_pending(attack.skill, t) then setup_command, category = attack.command..' '..t, 'affliction' break end end end
if setup_command then if duress.asphyxiate ~= true then return 'aero asphyxiate '..t,'smoke_tracking' end return setup_command, category end return pressure_command,'pressure' end
function M.buffet_ready() if (M.compression.level() or 0)<=2 then return false end local count=0 for _,aff in ipairs({'disloyalty','tension','manaleech','deadening'}) do if score(aff)>=100 then count=count+1 end end return count>=2 end function M.sync_buffet() local p=M.state.pending if not p or p.category~='buffet' then return end if M.buffet_ready() and not (ak and ak.defs and ak.defs.shield) and not M.compression.ready() then return end clear_staged(p.cmd) local q=Yso.queue local owned=q and type(q.get_owned)=='function' and q.get_owned('bal') or nil if owned and owned.route==M.key and owned.cmd==p.cmd and type(q.clear_lane)=='function' then q.clear_lane('bal') end M.state.pending=nil; M.state.staged_bal=nil end if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then if M.room_handler and type(killAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then killAnonymousEventHandler(M.room_handler) end M.room_handler=registerAnonymousEventHandler('gmcp.Room.Info',function() M.sync_updraft() end) end return M

Script.name: Airlord manual
Script.script: -- Manual aliases share Yso's target and emission API; never set a class target. Yso = Yso or {}; Yso.off=Yso.off or {}; Yso.off.airlord=Yso.off.airlord or {} local A=Yso.off.airlord function A.manual(skill,direction,distance) local route=A.lock if not route or not route.is_airlord() then return false end local r=Yso.ref.airlord.skills[skill] if not r or not r.syntax then return false end local cmd=r.syntax:match('^[^;]+'):lower() if skill=='glide' then if type(direction)~='string' or not direction:match('^[A-Za-z]+$') then return false end cmd='glide '..direction:lower() if distance~=nil and distance~='' then local n=tonumber(distance) if not n or n%1~=0 or n<1 or n>11 then return false end cmd=cmd..' '..tostring(n) end end local t if cmd:find('<target>',1,true) then t=Yso.get_target() local valid=Yso.target_is_valid or Yso.is_current_target if not t or t=='' or (type(valid)=='function' and not valid(t)) then return false end cmd=cmd:gsub('<target>',function() return t end) end local lane=r.lane or 'eq' -- Unobserved utility skills retain their existing lane. return Yso.emit({[lane]=cmd,target=t},{kind=skill=='mistral' and 'defense' or 'offense',reason='airlord:manual',commit=true,target=t,wake_lane=lane,free_immediate=lane=='free',repeat_command=true}) end return A

Script.name: Apostate reference
Script.script: -- In-game AB screenshots supplied 2026-10-19 take precedence over web descriptions. -- Reference data only: loading this file sends nothing and installs no handlers. Yso = Yso or {}; Yso.ref = Yso.ref or {}; Yso.ref.apostate = Yso.ref.apostate or {} local R = {meta={class='Apostate', skillset='Evileye', updated='2026-10-19', source_directory='C:/Users/shuji/OneDrive/Pictures/Screenshots', notes={'34 detailed AB entries; Truestare is index-confirmed only.', 'Cooldowns are the listed AB values, not a readiness timer.', 'Command keywords and AK score keys are deliberately separate.'}}, skills={}} Yso.ref.apostate.evileye = R local function eye(key, id, mana, aff, effect, stamp, works_on) R.skills[key] = {name=key:sub(1,1):upper()..key:sub(2), abadmin_id=id, syntax={'STARE <target> '..key:upper()}, works_on=works_on or 'adventurers', cooldown_s=1.90, cooldown_lane='balance', resource_mana=mana, affliction=aff, effect=effect, role=aff and 'affliction' or 'special', source='Screenshot 2026-10-19 '..stamp..'.png', details_captured=true, deadeyes_candidate=true} end eye('fear',80,33,nil,'Instils fear; R.skills.sicken.outcomes={'manaleech','slickness','damage'} eye('plague',103,75,'voyria','Afflicts with voyria.','193201') eye('addiction',104,70,'addiction','Causes addiction.','193201') eye('cowardice',105,150,nil,'Moves the victim in a random direction; does not cancel tumble from hindered opponents.', '193216','adventurers and denizens') eye('stupid',106,60,'stupidity','Causes stupidity.','193216') eye('manaleech',107,75,'manaleech','Saps the target mana.','193232') eye('sensitivity',108,70,'sensitivity','First removes deafness; a subsequent hit while hearing increases sensitivity to pain. Same conditional effect as prefarar from any source.','193232') R.skills.sensitivity.role='conditional' R.skills.sensitivity.outcomes={'deafness_removed','sensitivity'} eye('vomiting',109,75,'nausea','Induces severe vomiting.','193247') eye('sleep',110,55,'sleep','Puts the target to sleep or removes sleep defences; announcement alone does not distinguish outcomes.','193247') eye('anorexia',111,70,'anorexia','Prevents eating.','193256') eye('weariness',112,75,'weariness','Weakens the body.','193256') R.skills.deadeyes={name='Deadeyes',abadmin_id=95, syntax={'DEADEYES <target> <first evileye> <second evileye>'}, works_on='adventurers and denizens',cooldown_s=2.30,cooldown_lane='balance', resource_rule='Sum of both selected evileye mana costs.',role='combo', effect='Two simultaneous evileyes; becomes faster as Evileye skill increases.', source='Screenshot 2026-10-19 192811.png',details_captured=true,deadeyes_candidate=false} R.skills.truestare={name='Truestare',role='utility',details_captured=false,deadeyes_candidate=false, effect='Index description: cast the evileye through magical shields.', source='Earlier Evileye index screenshot; detailed AB not supplied.'} R.curseward={ak_key='ak.defs.curseward', separate_from='magical shield', up_message='A shimmering curseward appears around <target>.', down_message="<target>'s curseward shatters!", absent_message="Your attempt to breach <target>'s curseward has no effect.", source='Screenshot 2026-10-19 193004.png', notes={'Breach is defence removal, never a scored affliction.', 'AK treats the captured no-effect response as Curseward absent.', 'Live test 2026-10-20: Deadeyes breach impatience shattered Curseward before impatience landed; Breach must be first.'}} return R
