Script.name: Apostate utilities
Script.script:
-- Maintained source for the Mudlet Apostate utilities script. Yso = Yso or {}; Yso.apostate = Yso.apostate or {} local A = Yso.apostate A.trace_state = A.trace_state or { count = 0, interval = 2, party = false }
local function trim(s) return (tostring(s or ''):gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')) end local function note(s) if type(cecho) == 'function' then cecho('<DeepPink>[Apostate] <violet_red>' .. s .. '\n') end end local function person(s) return s:match("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'%-]*$") ~= nil end function A.active() local status = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status local class = status and (status.class or status.classname) or Yso.class return trim(class):lower() == 'apostate' end local function enabled() if A.active() then return true end note('This alias requires Apostate class.'); return false end local function current_target() local name = type(Yso.get_target) == 'function' and Yso.get_target() or nil name = trim(name) if not person(name) then note('Set a valid target first.'); return nil end return name end local function command(cmd, clear) if type(send) ~= 'function' then return false end if clear then send('cq all', false) end send(cmd, false); return true end
function A.alias(kind, arg) if not enabled() then return false end arg = trim(arg) local cmd if kind == 'beck' then if arg ~= '' and not person(arg) then note('Use beck [person].'); return false end cmd = 'demon beckon' .. (arg ~= '' and ' ' .. arg or '') elseif kind == 'melt' then if not arg:match('^[A-Za-z0-9_%-]+$') then note('Use dmelt <icewall>.'); return false end cmd = 'demon scorch ' .. arg elseif kind == 'shrivel' then arg = arg:lower():gsub('%s+', ' ') local limbs = {arms=true, legs=true, ['left arm']=true, ['right arm']=true, ['left leg']=true, ['right leg']=true} if not limbs[arg] then note('Use shriv arms|legs|left arm|right arm|left leg|right leg.'); return false end local target = current_target(); if not target then return false end cmd = 'shrivel ' .. arg .. ' ' .. target elseif kind == 'sap' or kind == 'strip' or kind == 'soulstorm' or (kind == 'blackwind' and arg == 'c') then local target = current_target(); if not target then return false end local verbs = {sap='demon sap', strip='demon strip', soulstorm='soulstorm', blackwind='choke'} cmd = verbs[kind] .. ' ' .. target else local choices = { siphon = {o='demon syphon', f='demon syphon off'}, pentagram = {c='carve pentagram', d='dispel pentagram'}, gravehands = {s='summon hands of the grave', b='banish hands of the grave'}, blackwind = {w='blackwind', h='human'}, } cmd = choices[kind] and choices[kind][arg] if not cmd then note('Invalid Apostate alias option.'); return false end end return command(cmd, true) end
function A.trace(prefix, name, interval) if not enabled() then return false end name = trim(name) if name:lower() == 'off' then return command('demon trace off', false) end interval = trim(interval) local every = interval == '' and 2 or tonumber(interval) if not person(name) or not every or every < 1 or every % 1 ~= 0 then note('Use [p]trace <person> [positive movement count], or trace off.'); return false end local s = A.trace_state s.target, s.count, s.interval, s.party = name, 0, every, prefix == 'p' command('demon trace ' .. name, false) if s.party then command('pt Tracing ' .. name .. ', reporting on ' .. every .. ' movements', false) end return true end function A.trace_started(name) local s = A.trace_state name = trim(name) if not s.target or s.target:lower() ~= name:lower() then s.party = false end s.target, s.count = name, 0 end function A.trace_moved(name, room) local s = A.trace_state if not A.active() or not s.target or trim(name):lower() ~= s.target:lower() then return end s.count = (s.count or 0) + 1 if not s.party then return end if room == 'On the clouds' then command('pt ' .. name .. " duanathar'd", false) end if s.count >= s.interval then command('pt ' .. name .. ' moved to ' .. room, false); s.count = 0 end end function A.trace_halted() local s = A.trace_state if s.party and A.active() then command('pt Tracing off', false) end s.target, s.count, s.party = nil, 0, false end function A.reset() A.baalzadeen, A.taste, A.pentagram = nil, nil, nil local s = A.trace_state s.target, s.count, s.party = nil, 0, false end
-- Only a fresh Contemplate response can request Catharsis. No delayed replay. function A.note_mana(name, current, maximum) -- Replies arrive in request order. Consume a cancelled route request before -- permitting the standalone helper to handle a later manual Contemplate. local key=type(name)=='string' and name:lower() or '' local cancelled=A.cancelled_contemplates and A.cancelled_contemplates[key] or 0 if cancelled>0 then A.cancelled_contemplates[key]=cancelled-1 return false end if not A.active() then return false end local victim = type(Yso.get_target) == 'function' and Yso.get_target() or nil if type(victim) ~= 'string' or not person(victim) or type(name) ~= 'string' or victim:lower() ~= name:lower() then return false end current, maximum = tonumber(current), tonumber(maximum) if not current or not maximum or maximum <= 0 or current < 0 or current > maximum or current ~= current or maximum ~= maximum or maximum == math.huge then return false end if Yso.tgt and type(Yso.tgt.set_mana_pct) == 'function' then Yso.tgt.set_mana_pct(victim, current * 100 / maximum) end local routes = Yso.off and Yso.off.apostate local route = routes and (type(routes.active_route)=='function' and routes.active_route() or routes.truelock) if route and route.is_enabled() then return type(route.note_mana)=='function' and route.note_mana(name,current,maximum) or false end if current * 2 >= maximum or type(sendAll) ~= 'function' then return false end local now = type(getEpoch) == 'function' and tonumber(getEpoch()) or os.time() if now > 20000000000 then now = now / 1000 end if A.catharsis_sent_at and now - A.catharsis_sent_at < 4.4 then return false end A.catharsis_sent_at = now sendAll('cq all', 'demon catharsis ' .. victim) return true end
-- Replace handlers on script reload instead of registering duplicate callbacks. if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) == 'function' then A.handlers = A.handlers or {} local events = { ['gmcp.Room.Info'] = function() local room = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info local id = room and room.num if id == nil or A.room_id ~= id then A.pentagram = nil end A.room_id = id end, ['sysDisconnectionEvent'] = function() A.reset(); A.room_id = nil; A.catharsis_sent_at = nil A.cancelled_corrupts={}; A.cancelled_contemplates={} end, ['gmcp.Char.Status'] = function() if not A.active() then A.reset() end end, } for event, fn in pairs(events) do if A.handlers[event] and type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == 'function' then killAnonymousEventHandler(A.handlers[event]) end A.handlers[event] = registerAnonymousEventHandler(event, fn) end end

Script.name: Apostate entourage
Script.script:
-- Daemonite-only balanceless orders. Summoning and pentagram setup stay manual. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.apostate = Yso.apostate or {} local E = Yso.apostate.entourage or {} Yso.apostate.entourage = E
local function dispatch(command) local sender = Yso.send if type(sender) == 'function' then local ok, result = pcall(sender, command) return ok and result == true end if type(send) ~= 'function' then return false end local ok, result = pcall(send, command, false) return ok and result ~= false end
function E.attack(target) if type(target) ~= 'string' or not target:match("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'%-]*$") then return false, 'invalid_target' end if E.target and E.target:lower() == target:lower() then return true end
-- A sender can fail after transmitting: preserve the need for cleanup. E.needs_passive = true E.target = nil if not dispatch('order daemonite kill ' .. target) then return false, 'send_failed' end E.target = target return true end
function E.passive() if not E.needs_passive then return true end E.target = nil if not dispatch('order daemonite passive') then return false, 'send_failed' end E.target = nil E.needs_passive = false return true end
return E

Script.name: Apostate Truelocks
Script.script:
-- Lock decisions are separate from delivery; AK owns confirmed target state. Yso=Yso or {};Yso.off=Yso.off or {};Yso.off.apostate=Yso.off.apostate or {} -- Both finishers share pressure/delivery code, but never state or ownership. function Yso.off.apostate.create_lock_route(kind) local vivisect=kind=='vivisect' local slot=vivisect and 'vivisect' or 'truelock' local M=Yso.off.apostate[slot] or {};Yso.off.apostate[slot]=M M.key=vivisect and 'apostate_vivisect' or 'apostate_truelock';M.alias_owned=true M.state=M.state or {};M.state.loop_delay=0.15 M.Affliction_giving={ 'paralysis','undeaf','impatience','asthma','masochism','manaleech','slickness','anorexia','disloyalty', } M.Padding_mental_afflictions={ 'stupidity','confusion','dizziness','dementia', } M.Padding_kelp_afflictions={ 'clumsiness','weariness','sensitivity', } M.undeaf_delivery='evileye' -- Optional: 'prefarar' uses Puncture when available. if vivisect then M.Affliction_giving[#M.Affliction_giving+1]='confusion' end -- Captured live output, 2026-10-26. Both lines are required: the command's -- acceptance does not establish which curse the Baalzadeen actually retained. local corrupt_success_pattern=[[^You command your baalzadeen to corrupt the soul of ([\w'-]+)\.$]] local corrupt_retained_pattern=[[^Your Baalzadeen informs you that the ([a-z]+) affliction still burdens ([\w'-]+)\.$]] function M.configure_corrupt_confirmation(pattern,retained_pattern) if M.corrupt_trigger and type(killTrigger)=='function' then killTrigger(M.corrupt_trigger) end if M.corrupt_retained_trigger and type(killTrigger)=='function' then killTrigger(M.corrupt_retained_trigger) end M.corrupt_trigger=nil;M.corrupt_retained_trigger=nil M.Corrupt_success_pattern=pattern;M.Corrupt_retained_pattern=retained_pattern if type(pattern)~='string' or pattern=='' or type(retained_pattern)~='string' or retained_pattern=='' or type(tempRegexTrigger)~='function' then return false end local ok,id=pcall(tempRegexTrigger,pattern,function() M.note_corrupt_started(matches[2]) end) if not ok or not tonumber(id) or tonumber(id)<=0 then return false end M.corrupt_trigger=id local retained_ok,retained_id=pcall(tempRegexTrigger,retained_pattern,function() M.note_corrupt(matches[3],matches[2]) end) if retained_ok and tonumber(retained_id) and tonumber(retained_id)>0 then M.corrupt_retained_trigger=retained_id;return true end if type(killTrigger)=='function' then killTrigger(M.corrupt_trigger) end M.corrupt_trigger=nil return false end local eyes={undeaf='sensitivity',clumsiness='clumsy',slickness='sicken',stupidity='stupid',dizziness='dizzy'} local function present(value) return value==true or (tonumber(value) or 0)>=100 end local function same(a,b) return type(a)=='string' and type(b)=='string' and a:lower()==b:lower() end local function valid(name) return type(name)=='string' and name:match("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'%-]*$") end local function victim() return type(Yso.get_target)=='function' and Yso.get_target() or '' end local function now() local t=type(getEpoch)=='function' and tonumber(getEpoch()) or os.time() return t>20000000000 and t/1000 or t end
local function confirmation_now() local P=Yso.Combat and Yso.Combat.Pause return P and P.confirmation_now(M.key) or now() end
-- Conditions control eligibility; the editable lists control giving order. function M.select(scores) local opening=not present(scores.asthma) or not present(scores.impatience) local needs_manaleech=not present(scores.manaleech) local eligible={paralysis=true,undeaf=true} if opening then eligible.impatience=true;eligible.asthma=true;eligible.masochism=true elseif needs_manaleech then eligible.manaleech=true else eligible.slickness=true;eligible.anorexia=true end local out,seen={},{} local function add(aff) -- AK's deaf=100 means deafness has been stripped; no new score is invented. local score=aff=='undeaf' and scores.deaf or scores[aff] if #out<2 and not seen[aff] and not present(score) then out[#out+1]=aff;seen[aff]=true end end -- Core eyes claim slots before padding, including Masochism. for _,aff in ipairs(M.Affliction_giving) do if eligible[aff] and aff~='masochism' then add(aff) end end if opening and #out==1 and out[1]=='asthma' then for _,aff in ipairs(M.Padding_kelp_afflictions) do add(aff) end end if opening then for _,aff in ipairs(M.Affliction_giving) do if aff=='masochism' then add(aff) end end end -- Retain mental padding for Impatience/Manaleech and exhausted kelp padding. if (opening and #out==1 and (out[1]=='asthma' or out[1]=='impatience')) or (not opening and needs_manaleech) then for _,aff in ipairs(M.Padding_mental_afflictions) do add(aff) end end return out end function M.eye_command(name,picks,curseward) if #picks==0 then return nil end local first=eyes[picks[1]] or picks[1] if curseward then return 'deadeyes '..name..' breach '..first end if picks[2] then return 'deadeyes '..name..' '..first..' '..(eyes[picks[2]] or picks[2]) end return 'stare '..name..' '..first end
local function note(text) if type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<DeepPink>['..(vivisect and 'Vivisect' or 'Truelocks')..'] <reset>'..text..'\n') end end function M.is_enabled() return M.state.loop_enabled==true end function M.is_active() return M.is_enabled() and Yso.apostate and Yso.apostate.active() and Yso.mode and Yso.mode.is_combat() end function M.stop(reason) if Yso.mode and Yso.mode.stop_route_loop then Yso.mode.stop_route_loop(M.key,reason,false) else M.state.loop_enabled=false;M.alias_loop_on_stopped({reason=reason}) end return false end function M.alias_loop_prepare_start(ctx) local other=Yso.off.apostate[vivisect and 'truelock' or 'vivisect'] if other and other.is_enabled() then other.stop('route_changed') end M.state.pending=nil;M.state.victim=nil;M.state.reason=nil M.state.finisher=nil M.state.confirmation_warning=nil M.state.quarantine_warning=nil M.state.commands={} M.state.bal_until=nil;M.state.eq_until=nil;M.state.startup_error=nil return ctx end function M.alias_loop_on_started() if M.state.creatures_ordered and M.state.victim then return end local name=victim() if not valid(name) then M.state.startup_error='no_target';return end if not (Yso.apostate and Yso.apostate.active()) then M.state.startup_error='wrong_class';return end if not same(name,target) then M.state.startup_error='ak_target_mismatch';return end local entourage=Yso.apostate.entourage if not entourage then M.state.startup_error='entourage_unavailable';return end M.state.victim=name;M.state.creatures_ordered=true if not entourage.attack(name) then M.state.startup_error='creature_orders_failed' end note('ON.') end function M.alias_loop_on_stopped(ctx) if M.state.creatures_ordered then local entourage=Yso.apostate and Yso.apostate.entourage if entourage and entourage.passive() then M.state.creatures_ordered=nil else note('Unable to send daemonite passive order.') end end -- Older profiles may still have route-owned compatibility queue entries. local Q=Yso.queue if Q and type(Q.get_owned)=='function' then for _,lane in ipairs({'bal','eq','free'}) do local command=M.state.commands and M.state.commands[lane] if command and type(Q.list)=='function' and Q.list(lane)==command and Q.clear then Q.clear(lane) end local owned=Q.get_owned(lane) if owned and owned.route==M.key then if Q.clear_lane then pcall(Q.clear_lane,lane) end end end end local pending=M.state.pending if pending and pending.action=='contemplate' and Yso.apostate then local A=Yso.apostate;local key=pending.target:lower() A.cancelled_contemplates=A.cancelled_contemplates or {} A.cancelled_contemplates[key]=(A.cancelled_contemplates[key] or 0)+1 elseif pending and pending.action=='corrupt' and Yso.apostate then local A=Yso.apostate;local key=pending.target:lower() A.cancelled_corrupts=A.cancelled_corrupts or {} A.cancelled_corrupts[key]=(A.cancelled_corrupts[key] or 0)+1 end M.state.pending=nil;M.state.finisher=nil;M.state.victim=nil;M.state.reason=nil if ak and ak.apostate then ak.apostate.pending_daegger_wipe=nil end note('OFF ('..tostring(ctx and ctx.reason or 'manual')..').') end function M.alias_loop_clear_waiting() M.state.waiting={} end function M.alias_loop_waiting_blocks() return false end function M.alias_loop_on_error() M.stop('route_error') end function M.reset_route_state(reason) if M.is_enabled() then M.stop(reason or 'external_reset') end end function M.status() return {enabled=M.is_enabled(),target=M.state.victim,reason=M.state.reason} end -- Explicit reconciliation only: use while stopped after verifying the cancelled -- commands cannot still reply. New requests never silently consume old replies. function M.clear_cancelled_finishers(name) if M.is_enabled() or not valid(name) then return false end local A=Yso.apostate if not A then return false end local key=name:lower() if A.cancelled_corrupts then A.cancelled_corrupts[key]=nil end if A.cancelled_contemplates then A.cancelled_contemplates[key]=nil end return true end local function ready(lane) local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local value=v[lane];if value==nil then value=v[lane=='bal' and 'balance' or 'equilibrium'] end return (value==true or tostring(value)=='1') and now()>=(M.state[lane..'_until'] or 0) and not (Yso.locks and type(Yso.locks.ready)=='function' and not Yso.locks.ready(lane)) end local function hold(reason) M.state.reason=reason;return false,reason end -- Server confirmations, never command sends, settle Corrupt's curse conversion. function M.note_corrupt_started(name) local p=M.state.pending if not M.is_active() or not p or p.action~='corrupt' or not same(name,p.target) or not same(name,victim()) or not same(name,target) then return false end if confirmation_now()-p.at>=10 then return M.stop('confirmation_timeout') end p.accepted=true return true end function M.note_corrupt(name,retained) local A=Yso.apostate local key=type(name)=='string' and name:lower() or '' local cancelled=A and A.cancelled_corrupts and A.cancelled_corrupts[key] or 0 if cancelled>0 then A.cancelled_corrupts[key]=cancelled-1;return false end local p=M.state.pending if not M.is_active() or not p or p.action~='corrupt' or not p.accepted or type(retained)~='string' or retained=='' or not same(name,p.target) or not same(name,victim()) or not same(name,target) then return false end if confirmation_now()-p.at>=10 then return M.stop('confirmation_timeout') end local A=ak and ak.apostate if not (A and type(A.consume_corrupt)=='function' and A.consume_corrupt(name,retained)) then return M.stop('corrupt_tracking_unavailable') end M.state.pending=nil if retained~='anorexia' then note('Corrupt retained '..retained..' instead of anorexia; stopping the finisher.') return M.stop('corrupt_retained_mismatch') end M.state.finisher={phase='contemplate',at=confirmation_now()} return true end function M.note_mana(name,current,maximum) local p=M.state.pending if not M.is_active() or not p or p.action~='contemplate' or not same(name,p.target) or not same(name,victim()) or not same(name,target) then return false end if confirmation_now()-p.at>=10 then return M.stop('confirmation_timeout') end current,maximum=tonumber(current),tonumber(maximum) if not current or not maximum or maximum<=0 or current<0 or current>maximum or current~=current or maximum~=maximum or maximum==math.huge then return false end M.state.pending=nil M.state.finisher={phase=current*2<maximum and 'catharsis' or 'sap',at=confirmation_now()} return true end local function emit_finisher(name,action) local A=Yso.apostate or {};local key=name:lower() if action=='corrupt' or action=='contemplate' then local blocked if A.cancelled_corrupts and (A.cancelled_corrupts[key] or 0)>0 then blocked='corrupt' elseif A.cancelled_contemplates and (A.cancelled_contemplates[key] or 0)>0 then blocked='contemplate' end if blocked then if not M.state.quarantine_warning then note('Finisher held: an earlier '..blocked..' reply remains unresolved. Stop and reconcile before retrying.') M.state.quarantine_warning=true end return hold('waiting_cancelled_'..blocked) end end if action=='corrupt' and not (M.corrupt_trigger and M.corrupt_retained_trigger) then if not M.state.confirmation_warning then note('Lock sealed; Corrupt awaits a verified success trigger.') M.state.confirmation_warning=true end return hold('corrupt_confirmation_unconfigured') end local lane=action=='contemplate' and 'free' or 'eq' if action=='contemplate' then -- Scheduling policy waits for balance; Contemplate itself spends neither lane. if not ready('bal') then return hold('balance') end elseif not ready('eq') then return hold('equilibrium') end local cmd=action=='contemplate' and ('contemplate '..name) or ('demon '..action..' '..name) if action=='corrupt' then cmd=cmd..' anorexia' end local payload={target=name,route=M.key};payload[lane]=cmd M.state.commands=M.state.commands or {};M.state.commands[lane]=cmd if action=='contemplate' then -- Send immediately: a balanceless query must not linger in the server queue. local sender=Yso.send or send if type(sender)~='function' then return hold('emit_blocked') end local ok,result=pcall(sender,cmd,false) if not ok or result==false or (sender==Yso.send and result~=true) then return hold('emit_blocked') end else local Q=Yso.queue local previous=Q and type(Q.get_owned)=='function' and Q.get_owned('eq') local function discard_staged() if Q and type(Q.list)=='function' and Q.list('eq')==cmd and Q.clear then Q.clear('eq') end end if type(Yso.emit)~='function' or Yso.emit(payload,{kind='offense',route=M.key,target=name, reason=M.key,commit=true})~=true then discard_staged();return hold('emit_blocked') end -- The canonical emitter may report a staged wake as success. Require actual -- ownership of a freshly dispatched EQ command before advancing the phase. if Q and type(Q.get_owned)=='function' then local owned=Q.get_owned('eq') if not owned or owned==previous or owned.route~=M.key or owned.cmd~=cmd then discard_staged() return hold('emit_blocked') end end end if action=='corrupt' or action=='contemplate' or action=='catharsis' then M.state.pending={target=name,cmd=cmd,at=confirmation_now(),action=action} end if lane=='eq' then M.state.eq_until=now()+({corrupt=3,sap=2.75,catharsis=4.4})[action] end M.state.reason='waiting_'..action if action=='sap' then M.state.finisher=nil;M.state.reason='rebuild_lock' end return true end function M.note_pressure(kind,name,delivered) local p=M.state.pending if not p or kind~=p.action or not same(name,p.target) or not same(name,victim()) then return end if kind=='puncture' and delivered~=true then return M.stop('venom_delivery_unconfirmed') end p.confirmed=true end function M.note_eye_rejected(reason,name) local p=M.state.pending if not M.is_enabled() or not p or (p.action~='eyes' and not vivisect) or not same(p.target,victim()) or (name and not same(name,p.target)) then return false end if p.action~='eyes' and reason~='equilibrium' and reason~='balance' then return false end if reason=='blind' then return M.stop('eyes_blind') end if reason~='equilibrium' and reason~='balance' and reason~='curseward' then return false end if reason=='curseward' then ak.defs=ak.defs or {};ak.defs.curseward=true end p.rejected=reason;return true end local function release_confirmed_owner(p) -- A confirmed/rejected command no longer needs client deduplication. Keep -- server queues intact and never release a replacement owned by another send. local Q=Yso.queue if vivisect and p.owned and Q and type(Q.get_owned)=='function' and Q.get_owned(p.lane)==p.owned and type(Q.clear_owned)=='function' then Q.clear_owned(p.lane) end end function M.note_prompt() local p=M.state.pending;if not p then return end if not same(p.target,victim()) then return M.stop('target_changed') end if p.action=='catharsis' or p.action=='vivisect' then if vivisect and p.rejected then release_confirmed_owner(p);M.state.pending=nil;return end local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local eq=v.eq;if eq==nil then eq=v.equilibrium end if eq==false or tostring(eq)=='0' then p.spent=true end return end if p.action=='trample' then local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local bal=v.bal;if bal==nil then bal=v.balance end if bal==false or tostring(bal)=='0' then p.confirmed=true end end if vivisect and p.action=='disfigure' then local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local eq=v.eq;if eq==nil then eq=v.equilibrium end if present(affstrack and affstrack.score and affstrack.score.disloyalty) or eq==false or tostring(eq)=='0' then p.confirmed=true end end if p.rejected or (p.confirmed and (not p.breach or (ak.defs and ak.defs.curseward==false))) then release_confirmed_owner(p);M.state.pending=nil end end function M.attack_function() if M.state.startup_error then return M.stop(M.state.startup_error) end if not M.is_active() then return hold('route_inactive') end local other=Yso.off.apostate[vivisect and 'truelock' or 'vivisect'] if other and other.is_enabled() then return hold('other_route_active') end local name=victim() if not valid(name) then return M.stop('no_target') end if M.state.victim and not same(name,M.state.victim) then return M.stop('target_changed') end if not same(name,target) then return hold('ak_target_mismatch') end if type(Yso.offense_paused)=='function' and Yso.offense_paused() then return hold('pause') end if Yso.inhibit and type(Yso.inhibit.active)=='function' and Yso.inhibit.active() then return hold('manual_suppression') end local vitals=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} if tostring(vitals.dead or '')=='1' then return M.stop('dead') end M.state.victim=name local pause=Yso.Combat and Yso.Combat.Pause if vivisect and not pause then local meta=Yso.selfaff and Yso.selfaff.meta if not (Yso.self and type(Yso.self.has_aff)=='function' and meta and meta.afflictions_ready==true and meta.full_sync_confirmed==true and meta.awaiting_full_sync~=true) then return hold('self_tracking_unavailable') end end if pause then local blocked,reason=pause.blocked(M.key) if blocked then return hold(reason) end elseif Yso.self and type(Yso.self.has_aff)=='function' and Yso.self.has_aff('paralysis') then return hold('paralysis') end local pending=M.state.pending if pending then if pending.action=='catharsis' or pending.action=='vivisect' then M.note_prompt() if pending.rejected then M.state.pending=nil;return hold('replan') end if pending.spent and ready('eq') then return M.stop(vivisect and 'vivisect_attempt_complete' or 'catharsis_complete') end end if confirmation_now()-pending.at>=10 then return M.stop('confirmation_timeout') end return hold('waiting_'..pending.action) end if Yso.self and type(Yso.self.has_aff)=='function' and Yso.self.has_aff('paralysis') then return hold('paralysis') end if not (ak and affstrack and type(affstrack.score)=='table') then return hold('tracking_unavailable') end local finisher=M.state.finisher if finisher then if confirmation_now()-finisher.at>=10 then return M.stop('finisher_timeout') end return emit_finisher(name,finisher.phase) end local scores=affstrack.score local picks=M.select(scores) if vivisect and #picks==0 and present(scores.disloyalty) and not present(scores.confusion) then picks={'confusion'} end local lane,cmd,cost,breach='bal',nil,0,ak.defs and ak.defs.curseward local action='eyes' if #picks>0 then -- Curseward is eye shielding. Magical shield does not block Truestare eyes. if not ready('bal') then return hold('balance') end local D=Yso.apostate.daegger if picks[1]=='undeaf' and M.undeaf_delivery=='prefarar' and not (ak.defs and ak.defs.shield) and D and D.available('prefarar') then local commands=D.build_attack('puncture',name,'prefarar') if not commands then return hold('prefarar_unavailable') end cmd=table.concat(commands,Yso.sep or (Yso.cfg and Yso.cfg.cmd_sep) or '&&') action='puncture';breach=false else cmd=M.eye_command(name,picks,breach) local keys=breach and {'breach',eyes[picks[1]] or picks[1]} or picks local R=Yso.ref and Yso.ref.apostate and Yso.ref.apostate.evileye for _,key in ipairs(keys) do local ref=R and R.skills[eyes[key] or key] if not ref then return hold('unsupported_eye:'..key) end cost=cost+(ref.resource_mana or 0) end end else if not (present(scores.paralysis) and present(scores.impatience) and present(scores.asthma) and present(scores.manaleech) and present(scores.slickness) and present(scores.anorexia)) then return hold('no_eligible_eye') end local enabled=false for _,aff in ipairs(M.Affliction_giving) do if aff=='disloyalty' then enabled=true end end if not enabled then return hold('lock_complete') end if ak.defs and ak.defs.shield then return hold('shield') end if not present(scores.disloyalty) then lane='eq';cmd='disfigure '..name elseif not vivisect then return emit_finisher(name,'corrupt') else local all=true for _,limb in ipairs({'leftarm','rightarm','leftleg','rightleg'}) do if not present(scores[limb]) then all=false end end if all then lane='eq';cmd='vivisect '..name;action='vivisect';cost=300 else if not present(scores.prone) then return hold('waiting_prone') end if not ready('bal') then return hold('balance') end cmd='trample';action='trample' end end end if (lane=='eq' or action=='eyes') and not ready('eq') then return hold('equilibrium') end local mana=tonumber(vitals.mp or vitals.mana) if mana and mana<cost then return hold('mana') end local payload={target=name,route=M.key};payload[lane]=cmd -- Record before emission: a throwing sender can leave a staged queue entry. M.state.commands=M.state.commands or {};M.state.commands[lane]=cmd local Q=Yso.queue local previous=Q and type(Q.get_owned)=='function' and Q.get_owned(lane) local function discard_staged() if Q and type(Q.list)=='function' and Q.list(lane)==cmd and Q.clear then Q.clear(lane) end end if action=='puncture' and ak.apostate then ak.apostate.pending_daegger_wipe=true end if type(Yso.emit)~='function' or Yso.emit(payload,{kind='offense',route=M.key,target=name,reason=M.key,commit=true})~=true then if action=='puncture' and ak.apostate then ak.apostate.pending_daegger_wipe=nil end if vivisect then discard_staged() end return hold('emit_blocked') end if vivisect and Q and type(Q.get_owned)=='function' then local owned=Q.get_owned(lane) if not owned or owned==previous or owned.route~=M.key or owned.cmd~=cmd then discard_staged();return hold('emit_blocked') end end M.state[lane..'_until']=now()+(action=='vivisect' and 4 or (action=='trample' and 4 or (lane=='eq' and 3 or (action=='puncture' and 2.15 or 1.9)))) if lane=='bal' or vivisect then M.state.pending={target=name,cmd=cmd,at=confirmation_now(),breach=action=='eyes' and breach or false, action=action=='eyes' and lane=='eq' and 'disfigure' or action,lane=lane, owned=Q and type(Q.get_owned)=='function' and Q.get_owned(lane) or nil} end M.state.reason=lane=='bal' and ('waiting_'..action) or 'disfigure' return true end if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then M.handlers=M.handlers or {} local events={ ['yso.target.changed']=function() if M.is_enabled() then M.stop('target_changed') end end, ['yso.target.cleared']=function() if M.is_enabled() then M.stop('no_target') end end, ['sysDisconnectionEvent']=function() if M.is_enabled() then M.stop('disconnect') end if Yso.apostate then Yso.apostate.cancelled_corrupts={};Yso.apostate.cancelled_contemplates={} end end, ['gmcp.Char.Status']=function() if M.is_enabled() and not Yso.apostate.active() then M.stop('wrong_class') end end, } for event,fn in pairs(events) do if M.handlers[event] and type(killAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then killAnonymousEventHandler(M.handlers[event]) end M.handlers[event]=registerAnonymousEventHandler(event,fn) end end if not vivisect then M.configure_corrupt_confirmation(corrupt_success_pattern,corrupt_retained_pattern) end return M end function Yso.off.apostate.active_route() local V=Yso.off.apostate.vivisect if V and V.is_enabled() then return V end return Yso.off.apostate.truelock end return Yso.off.apostate.create_lock_route('truelock')

Script.name: Apostate Vivisect
Script.script: -- Shared pressure engine; independent route state and limb-based finisher. return Yso.off.apostate.create_lock_route('vivisect')

Script.name: Apostate daegger envenom
Script.script: -- Balanceless preparation, called only immediately before a venom-delivering attack. Yso=Yso or {};Yso.apostate=Yso.apostate or {} local D=Yso.apostate.daegger or {};Yso.apostate.daegger=D D.stock=D.stock or {curare=true,kalmia=true,slike=true,gecko=true,vernalius=true, aconite=true,eurypteria=true,voyria=true,selarnia=true,notechis=false,delphinium=true, xentio=true,prefarar=true,epseth=true,digitalis=false} -- The first padding release assumed Digitalis stock that was never confirmed. -- Discard that legacy assumption on reimport; preserve measured doses and later overrides. if (tonumber(D.stock_defaults_version) or 0)<1 then if D.stock.digitalis==true then D.stock.digitalis=false end D.stock_defaults_version=1 end if D.stock.digitalis==nil then D.stock.digitalis=false end local standard={xentio=true,eurypteria=true,kalmia=true,delphinium=true,digitalis=true, darkshade=true,curare=true,epteth=true,prefarar=true,monkshood=true,euphorbia=true, colocasia=true,vernalius=true,epseth=true,larkspur=true,slike=true,notechis=true, vardrax=true,aconite=true,selarnia=true,gecko=true,scytherus=true,voyria=true} local preferred={paralysis='curare',asthma='kalmia',slickness='gecko',anorexia='slike', weariness='vernalius',stupidity='aconite',recklessness='eurypteria',voyria='voyria', haemophilia='notechis',selarnia='selarnia',shyness='digitalis'} function D.venom_for(aff) local v=preferred[aff] local map=affstrack and affstrack.venoms or {} if v and map[v]==aff then return v end local keys={};for venom,outcome in pairs(map) do if standard[venom] and outcome==aff then keys[#keys+1]=venom end end table.sort(keys);return keys[1] end function D.available(venom) local n=D.stock[venom];return n==true or (tonumber(n) or 0)>0 end function D.select_venom(profile,snapshot) for _,aff in ipairs(profile or {}) do local value=(snapshot or {})[aff] if value~=true and (tonumber(value) or 0)<100 then local v=D.venom_for(aff) if v and D.available(v) then return v,aff end end end return nil,'no_available_venom' end function D.build_attack(action,victim,venom) local verb=({puncture='daegger puncture',stab='stab'})[action] if not verb or type(victim)~='string' or not victim:match("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'%-]*$") or not standard[venom] or not (affstrack and affstrack.venoms and affstrack.venoms[venom]) then return nil,'invalid_attack' end return {'wipe daegger','envenom daegger with '..venom,verb..' '..victim} end function D.note_application(venom,weapon) if type(weapon)~='string' or not weapon:lower():find('daegger',1,true) then return end if type(D.stock[venom])=='number' then D.stock[venom]=math.max(0,D.stock[venom]-1) end end function D.emit_attack(action,victim,profile,snapshot) local venom,aff=D.select_venom(profile,snapshot) if not venom then return false,aff end local cmds,why=D.build_attack(action,victim,venom);if not cmds then return false,why end if not Yso.emit then return false,'emitter_unavailable' end local A=ak and ak.apostate if A then A.pending_daegger_wipe=true end -- Keep preparation and attack in one ordered BAL batch. A separate "free" -- lane may be server-queued behind EQ in compatible queue-enabled profiles. local sep=Yso.sep or (Yso.cfg and (Yso.cfg.cmd_sep or Yso.cfg.pipe_sep)) or '&&' local ok=Yso.emit({target=victim,bal=table.concat(cmds,sep)}, {kind='offense',route='apostate_truelock',target=victim,reason='apostate_truelock',commit=true})==true if not ok and A then A.pending_daegger_wipe=nil end return ok,aff end return D

Script.name: Deadeye combo sorter
Script.script: -- Pure preparation helpers. No alias, send, timer, or route registration. Yso=Yso or {};Yso.apostate=Yso.apostate or {} local D=Yso.apostate.deadeyes or {};Yso.apostate.deadeyes=D D.priorities=D.priorities or {} local function catalog() return Yso.ref and Yso.ref.apostate and Yso.ref.apostate.evileye end local function present(value) return value==true or (tonumber(value) or 0)>=100 end function D.build(target,first,second) local R=catalog() if type(target)~='string' or not target:match("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'%-]*$") then return nil,'invalid_target' end for _,key in ipairs({first or '',second or ''}) do if type(key)~='string' or not R or not R.skills[key] or not R.skills[key].deadeyes_candidate then return nil,'invalid_evileye' end end return 'deadeyes '..target..' '..first..' '..second end function D.select(priorities,afflictions) local R=catalog();if not R then return nil,nil,'reference_unavailable' end local snapshot={};for k,v in pairs(afflictions or {}) do snapshot[k]=v end local selected,seen={},{} for _,entry in ipairs(priorities or D.priorities) do local key=type(entry)=='table' and entry.keyword or entry local skill=R.skills[key] if skill and skill.deadeyes_candidate and not seen[key] then seen[key]=true local aff=type(entry)=='table' and entry.affliction or skill.affliction if key=='sicken' then aff=not present(snapshot.manaleech) and 'manaleech' or (not present(snapshot.slickness) and 'slickness' or nil) end local eligible=type(entry)~='table' or not entry.eligible or entry.eligible(snapshot,skill) -- General pressure selection uses tracked afflictions, not defence breaks or unspecified damage. if eligible and aff and not present(snapshot[aff]) then selected[#selected+1]=key;snapshot[aff]=100 if #selected==2 then return selected[1],selected[2] end end end end return nil,nil,'insufficient_candidates' end return D

Script.name: Yso unified health
Script.script:
-- Read-only system diagnostics. Loading this service never queries the game. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.system = Yso.system or {} local S = Yso.system S.version = 1 local expected = {'Legacy V2.1', 'AK', 'limb.1.2', 'Yso system', 'Legacy Basher V2.1', 'Legacy UI V2.0', 'Yso Workspace Link'}
local function call(fn, ...) if type(fn) ~= 'function' then return false, 'unavailable' end return pcall(fn, ...) end local function resolve(path) local value = _G for part in tostring(path or ''):gmatch('[^.]+') do if type(value) ~= 'table' then return nil end value = value[part] end return value end local function contains(list, name) if type(list) ~= 'table' then return false end if list[name] then return true end for _, value in ipairs(list) do if value == name then return true end end return false end local function count(t) local n = 0 for _ in pairs(type(t) == 'table' and t or {}) do n = n + 1 end return n end local function text(value) if type(value) ~= 'string' and type(value) ~= 'number' then return '' end return tostring(value):gsub('[<>
]', '') end
function S.check(opts) opts = type(opts) == 'table' and opts or {} local scope = opts.scope or 'runtime' local report = {ok = true, scope = scope, checks = {}, counts = {pass=0,warn=0,blocked=0,disabled=0}} local function add(id, status, detail, recovery) report.checks[#report.checks+1] = {id=id, status=status, detail=tostring(detail or ''), recovery=tostring(recovery or '')} report.counts[status] = (report.counts[status] or 0) + 1 if status == 'blocked' then report.ok = false end end if scope ~= 'runtime' and scope ~= 'install' then add('scope', 'blocked', 'Unknown check scope', 'Use runtime or install.') return report end for _, name in ipairs({'send','registerAnonymousEventHandler','getPackages','getModules'}) do local available = type(_G[name]) == 'function' add('api.'..name, available and 'pass' or 'blocked', available and 'Available' or 'Required Mudlet API unavailable', 'Use a supported Mudlet profile.') end local ready, authenticated = call(Yso.session and Yso.session.is_ready) if scope == 'runtime' then add('session', ready and authenticated == true and 'pass' or 'blocked', ready and authenticated == true and 'Fresh character session confirmed' or 'Not authenticated or session service unavailable', 'Log in normally and wait for fresh character GMCP; do not start offense yet.') else add('session', 'disabled', 'Authentication is not required for offline installation') end local okp, packages = call(getPackages) local okm, modules = call(getModules) for _, name in ipairs(expected) do local pkg = okp and contains(packages, name) local mod = okm and contains(modules, name) local status = pkg and mod and 'blocked' or (pkg or mod) and 'pass' or scope == 'install' and 'warn' or 'blocked' add('package.'..name, status, pkg and mod and 'Both package and module installed' or (pkg or mod) and 'Installed' or 'Not installed', 'Apply the coordinated bundle while disconnected, then restart the profile.') end if scope == 'runtime' then local ak_ready=type(ak)=='table' and type(affstrack)=='table' and type(affstrack.score)=='table' add('dependency.ak', ak_ready and 'pass' or 'blocked', ak_ready and 'AK namespace and opponent scores available' or 'AK namespace or opponent scores missing', 'Check AK installation and script errors.') add('dependency.legacy', type(Legacy) == 'table' and type(Legacy.Curing) == 'table' and 'pass' or 'blocked', 'Legacy curing integration', 'Check Legacy installation, initialization and saved settings.') end local suspended = not (Yso.features and Yso.features.alchemist_offense == true) add('feature.alchemist_offense', suspended and 'disabled' or 'pass', suspended and 'Alchemist offense intentionally suspended; shared tracking and curing remain available' or 'Alchemist offense explicitly enabled') local bridge_ok, bridge = call(YsoWorkspaceLink and YsoWorkspaceLink.status, false) if not bridge_ok or type(bridge) ~= 'table' then add('release', scope == 'install' and 'warn' or 'blocked', 'Release status unavailable', 'Install the bundled workspace controller and inspect ysostatus.') else local release = type(bridge.release) == 'table' and bridge.release or {} local restart = bridge.restart_required == true or release.restart_required == true local proof = release.consistent == true and type(release.id)=='string' and release.id~='' local checked = {} for _, row in ipairs(type(release.packages)=='table' and release.packages or {}) do if type(row)~='table' or type(row.name)~='string' or checked[row.name] or row.installed~=true or row.consistent~=true then proof=false else checked[row.name]=true end end for _, name in ipairs(expected) do if not checked[name] then proof=false end end add('release', bridge.busy and 'blocked' or bridge.last_error and 'blocked' or not proof and (scope=='install' and 'warn' or 'blocked') or 'pass', bridge.busy and 'Update in progress' or bridge.last_error and ('Update failed: '..text(bridge.last_error)) or not proof and 'Installed packages do not prove a complete consistent release' or 'Release '..text(release.id or 'unversioned'), 'Inspect ysostatus and complete release recovery before resuming.') add('release.restart', restart and scope == 'runtime' and 'blocked' or restart and 'warn' or 'pass', restart and 'Profile restart required' or 'No restart requirement reported', 'Restart the profile after the full update.') if bridge.changed then add('release.pending','warn','Workspace changes have not been applied','Verify and apply the intended release.') end for _, row in ipairs(release.packages or {}) do if row.ok == false or row.match == false or row.installed == false or row.consistent == false then add('release.package.'..text(row.id or row.name),'blocked','Package release mismatch: '..text(row.name or row.id),'Apply one complete release; do not mix package versions.') end end for _, conflict in ipairs(release.conflicts or {}) do add('release.conflict.'..text(type(conflict)=='table' and conflict.name or conflict),'warn', 'Overlapping optional package detected','Review before installing overlapping targeting or Stormhammer packages.') end end if scope == 'runtime' then local C = Yso.curing or {} local good, policy = call(C.policy and C.policy.status) if good and type(policy) == 'table' then local current=policy.current_set if type(current)~='string' or current=='' then current=Legacy and Legacy.Curing and Legacy.Curing.ActiveServerSet end local known=policy.set_untrusted==false and type(current)=='string' and current~='' add('curing', known and 'pass' or 'blocked', policy.set_untrusted and 'Server curing state is untrusted: '..text(policy.set_untrusted_reason) or known and 'Active curing set: '..text(current) or 'Server curing state is unknown', 'Confirm the server curingset and resynchronize curing.') else add('curing','blocked','Curing policy diagnostics unavailable','Check Yso and Legacy curing initialization.') end local paused = Yso.pause and Yso.pause.offense add('offense.pause', paused and paused.active and 'warn' or 'pass', paused and paused.active and ('Offense paused: '..text(paused.reason)) or 'No manual offense pause reported') local registry = Yso.Combat and Yso.Combat.RouteRegistry local ids_ok, ids = call(registry and registry.active_ids) if not ids_ok or type(ids) ~= 'table' then add('routes','blocked','Route registry unavailable','Check script load order and package consistency.') else local active = '' local active_ok, selected = call(Yso.mode and Yso.mode.active_route_id) if active_ok then active = selected or '' end for _, id in ipairs(ids) do local resolved, entry = call(registry.resolve, id) local route = resolved and type(entry)=='table' and resolve(entry.namespace) if type(route) ~= 'table' then add('route.'..id,'blocked','Registered route implementation missing','Rebuild and apply matching route packages.') elseif active == id or route.state and route.state.loop_enabled == true then -- Existing explain() methods may initialize planners, reset a target, -- or clear pending confirmations. Read their last recorded state only. local state = route.state or {} local why = type(state.explain)=='table' and state.explain or {} local detail = type(why)=='table' and (why.reason or why.blocker or why.hold_reason or why.phase) or nil detail = detail or state.last_hold_reason or state.reason or state.template and state.template.last_reason if not detail or detail == '' then detail = 'Active; detailed route explanation unavailable' end add('route.'..id,'warn',detail,'Inspect the reported blocker and route confirmation state.') if state.pending or state.waiting and (state.waiting.reason or '') ~= '' then add('route.pending.'..id,'warn','Route has pending confirmation work','Wait for confirmation; stop the route before applying updates.') end end end end for _, lane in ipairs({'eq','bal','class','free'}) do local q = Yso.queue if q then local staged_ok, staged = call(q.list, lane) local owned_ok, owned = call(q.get_owned, lane) if staged_ok and (type(staged)=='string' and staged~='' or type(staged)=='table' and next(staged)) or owned_ok and owned then add('queue.'..lane,'warn','Commands staged or owned on '..lane,'Stop automation and drain or clear owned commands before an update.') end end end local class = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status and gmcp.Char.Status.class or Yso.class if tostring(class or ''):lower() == 'magi' then local ids = Yso.magi and Yso.magi.weapons and Yso.magi.weapons.ids or {} add('equipment.magi', tostring(ids.staff or '')~='' and 'pass' or 'warn', tostring(ids.staff or '')~='' and 'Staff discovered' or 'Staff has not been discovered', 'Request equipment discovery after authentication and verify the staff.') end local ndb_ok, ndb = call(Legacy and Legacy.NDB and Legacy.NDB.network_status) add('ndb.refresh', ndb_ok and type(ndb)=='table' and ndb.refresh_enabled == true and 'pass' or 'warn', ndb_ok and type(ndb)=='table' and ndb.mode == 'cache_only' and 'NDB uses cached records; secure refresh unavailable' or 'Secure character refresh is unavailable', 'Use cached or in-game character information; insecure HTTP refresh is disabled.') local D = Yso.apostate and Yso.apostate.daegger if D and type(D.stock)=='table' then local assumed = 0 for _, value in pairs(D.stock) do if value == true then assumed = assumed+1 end end add('supplies.apostate', assumed > 0 and 'warn' or 'pass', assumed > 0 and 'Some venom availability is configured rather than measured' or 'Venom availability has no optimistic boolean defaults', 'Confirm actual venom stock before enabling offense.') end local F = Yso.alc and Yso.alc.form if not suspended and F then add('supplies.alchemist', count(F.phials)>0 and 'pass' or 'warn', count(F.phials)>0 and 'Phial inventory available' or 'Phial inventory unknown', 'Refresh phial inventory after obtaining Alchemist access.') end local handlers = count(Yso.session and Yso.session.handlers) local timers = count(Yso.session and Yso.session.timers) add('startup.pending', timers>0 and 'warn' or 'pass', tostring(timers)..' session timers; '..tostring(handlers)..' session handlers', 'Allow startup to finish; repeated checks can reveal accumulating work.') end if opts.echo ~= false and type(cecho) == 'function' then cecho('<steel_blue>[Yso check] <reset>'..(report.ok and 'No blocking checks' or 'Action required')..'
') for _, row in ipairs(report.checks) do cecho(' '..row.status:upper()..' '..text(row.id)..': '..text(row.detail)..'
') if row.status == 'blocked' and row.recovery ~= '' then cecho(' '..text(row.recovery)..'
') end end end return report end return S
